title: Senior Project Manager
description:
**Role Summary**

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and
**exceptionally strong communicator**
to manage and coordinate multiple concurrent initiatives within a Digital Supply Chain Platform for our client.

The Project Manager will work closely with Business Product Owners, Business Users, Release Train Engineers (RTEs), and technology delivery teams to ensure seamless planning, execution, deployment, and stakeholder communication across the platform.

The role requires someone who can connect the dots across multiple workstreams, proactively identify risks and dependencies, drive accountability, and provide clear visibility into overall platform progress.

**Strong business communication, stakeholder engagement and the ability to independently drive initiatives are critical success factors for this role.**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Integrated Project & Deployment Planning**

* Develop and maintain an integrated project and deployment roadmap covering multiple concurrent initiatives, enhancements, and releases.
* Collaborate with Business Product Owners, RTEs, and delivery teams to align priorities, milestones, release schedules, and dependencies.
* Track project progress against committed timelines and proactively identify potential delays or conflicts.
* Coordinate release readiness activities, business validations, and deployment communications.
* Ensure alignment between individual project plans and the broader platform roadmap.

**2. Project Governance, Risks & Issues**

* Establish and maintain structured tracking of project milestones, risks, issues, dependencies, and action items.
* Proactively follow up with stakeholders to drive resolution of open items and remove execution bottlenecks.
* Facilitate regular project reviews and governance meetings with business and technology stakeholders.
* Escalate critical risks, delays, and decisions to appropriate stakeholders with clear recommendations.
* Drive accountability and timely closure of commitments across teams.

**3. Business Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as a central coordination point between Business Product Owners, business users, RTEs, and delivery teams.
* Build strong working relationships with stakeholders across different business functions and organizational levels.
* Facilitate discussions to clarify priorities, business expectations, and delivery commitments.
* Translate project progress, technical updates, and delivery challenges into clear, business-friendly communication.
* Ensure business stakeholders remain informed and engaged throughout the project lifecycle.

**4. Status Reporting & Leadership Communication**

* Prepare consolidated weekly and monthly platform status reports covering accomplishments, upcoming milestones, risks, issues, and key decisions.
* Develop executive-level dashboards, presentations, and updates highlighting overall platform health and delivery progress.
* Communicate project achievements, business impact, and upcoming releases in a concise and compelling manner.
* Provide leadership with actionable insights rather than simply reporting activities.
* Maintain consistency, accuracy, and transparency across all project communications.

**5. Platform Communication, Engagement & Adoption**

* **Own and execute the platform communication and stakeholder engagement plan.**
* Plan, coordinate, and facilitate monthly webinars showcasing platform capabilities, recent enhancements, upcoming releases, and business value.
* Organize business roadshows, platform demonstrations, and stakeholder engagement sessions.
* Develop newsletters, internal articles, release announcements, success stories, and other communication materials.
* Partner with Product Owners and business teams to highlight platform achievements, adoption, and measurable business benefits.
* Ensure communications are engaging, professionally presented, and tailored to different audiences.
* Gather stakeholder feedback and identify opportunities to improve platform awareness and adoption.

**6. Continuous Improvement & Execution Excellence**

* Establish standardized templates and processes for planning, reporting, governance, and communication.
* Identify opportunities to improve cross-team collaboration, delivery predictability, and stakeholder engagement.
* Drive follow-through on decisions and commitments with minimal supervision.
* Promote a culture of ownership, transparency, and proactive communication.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* 12-15 years of experience in Project Management, Program Coordination, or PMO roles within the IT industry.
* Proven experience managing multiple concurrent projects or workstreams in a complex business and technology environment.
* Experience working with Business Product Owners, business stakeholders, Agile delivery teams, and Release Train Engineers.
* Strong understanding of Agile/SAFe delivery practices, release planning, and cross-team dependency management.
* Demonstrated ability to maintain integrated project plans, RAID logs, executive status reports, and stakeholder communication plans.
* Experience creating professional presentations, newsletters, webinar content, and business communications.
* Proficiency in PowerPoint, Excel, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and project tracking tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.
* Exposure to supply chain platforms, enterprise applications, or digital transformation programs is strongly preferred.

**Critical Competencies – Must Have**

**1. Exceptional Communication Skills**

Outstanding written and verbal communication skills are mandatory. The candidate must be able to articulate complex information clearly, create compelling presentations, confidently facilitate meetings, and communicate effectively with both business users and senior leadership.

**2. Strong Ownership & Follow-Through**

Must demonstrate the ability to independently drive activities, proactively follow up with stakeholders, challenge delays constructively, and ensure commitments are delivered.

**3. Stakeholder Management & Influence**

Ability to work across teams and influence outcomes without direct reporting authority.

**4. Planning & Organizational Excellence**

Strong ability to manage competing priorities, maintain integrated plans, and coordinate multiple moving pieces without losing sight of overall objectives.

**5. Business Orientation**

Ability to understand business priorities, communicate platform value, and connect project outcomes to business benefits.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting digital supply chain, logistics, planning, inventory management, or enterprise transformation platforms.
* Prior experience in a large multinational organization with distributed business and technology teams.
* Exposure to platform adoption, change management, or internal communication campaigns.
* PMP, CSM, SAFe, or equivalent project management certification is a plus.

**Key Deliverables**

* Integrated Platform Project & Deployment Roadmap
* Consolidated Project Status Dashboard and Executive Reporting
* Centralized RAID and Cross-Project Dependency Tracker
* Release Readiness and Deployment Communication Plan
* Monthly Platform Webinar and Presentation Materials
* Business Roadshow and Stakeholder Engagement Calendar
* Platform Newsletters, Articles, and Success Stories
* Stakeholder Communication and Engagement Plan

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will bring structure, predictability, and visibility to a portfolio of concurrent digital supply chain initiatives while ensuring that business stakeholders remain informed, engaged, and confident in the platform's progress.

This is not simply a project tracking role.

**We are looking for someone who can drive execution, connect stakeholders, communicate with impact, and create a strong professional presence for the Digital Supply Chain Platform across the organization.**

**About SwitchON Foundation & Greenovation Accelerator**

SwitchON Foundation (est. 2008) is a mission-driven organization working to strengthen
**sustainable agriculture, rural livelihoods, and climate resilience**
. We partner with Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs), climate startups, investors, and institutions to build scalable solutions that create both economic and social impact.

The
**Greenovation Accelerator**
is our flagship platform for climate-focused startups, SMEs, FPOs, and FPCs working across agriculture, circularity, clean energy, resilience, and other areas of climate action. Through challenge programs, bootcamps, capacity building, mentorship, market linkages, and connections to capital, Greenovation helps promising organizations strengthen their business foundations and progress toward investment readiness and scale.

**Position Overview**

The
**Greenovation Accelerator Co-Lead**
will lead the end-to-end operational execution, capacity building, and ecosystem coordination for SwitchON’s flagship accelerator programs. Based in Kolkata or Bangalore (Hybrid), this role requires strong program management, field execution, deal flow sourcing, and startup engagement capabilities.

You will work directly with early-stage climate startups, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), NGO partners, mentors, and internal teams to deliver high-impact bootcamps and foster founder communities. This role is highly execution-oriented and suited for an experienced professional who thrives in fast-moving, entrepreneurial, and impact-driven environments.

**Program Execution & Operations:**

* Lead end-to-end operational execution and coordination of accelerator cohorts, challenges, webinars, and ecosystem engagements.

**Startup, FPO & Ecosystem Deal Flow:**

* Handle application screening, due diligence support, eligibility evaluations, and panel logistics.

**Capacity Building & Founder Mentorship:**

* Design and deliver capacity-building workshops, bootcamps, and structured learning journeys tailored to startup and FPO needs.
* Identify capability gaps across cohorts and onboard relevant mentors, trainers, industry experts, and speakers.

**Investment & Startup Readiness Support:**

* Connect high-potential startups and FPOs directly with investment teams for catalytic grant and equity funding opportunities.
* Assist founders with startup readiness assessments, data room preparation, and pitch deck refinement.
* Support due diligence processes and investor review sessions.

**Community & Stakeholder Coordination:**

* Build and nurture a vibrant community network among cohort founders, alumni, mentors, and ecosystem enablers.
* Maintain program dashboards, trackers, and documentation to prepare clear progress updates for leadership and partners.

title: Kapture CX - Senior Customer Experience Manager
description:
**About Kapture CX**
Founded in Bengaluru in 2014, Kapture CX began as an enterprise customer support software company and has evolved into an AI-first Agentic Operating System for Enterprises.
  
  
Kapture helps enterprises scale AI execution while keeping humans in control. Its AgentOS platform enables enterprises to deploy, orchestrate, monitor, and optimize AI agents across critical business workflows - including customer support, sales, collections, and claims. Kapture's AI agents can execute workflows end-to-end across voice, chat, email, messaging, and social channels, with human intervention built in wherever judgment, empathy, or decision-making is required.
  
  
Today, Kapture is trusted by 1,000+ enterprises across 18 countries, helping organizations transform customer experience, automate complex workflows, and drive measurable business outcomes through AI Agents, Agentic AI, Voice AI, Conversational AI, and intelligent automation.
  
  
**What is this role all about?**
As a Senior Customer Experience Manager, you will own the success and growth of a portfolio of enterprise customers on the Kapture platform. You will act as a trusted partner to both business and technical stakeholders, driving CSAT, customer adoption, platform value, advocacy, retention, and long-term account health.
  
  
You will combine customer engagement, business understanding, technical expertise, and strong delivery capabilities to help customers achieve their objectives on Kapture. You will also identify opportunities for platform optimization, solutioning, and account growth while partnering closely with internal teams to resolve complex challenges and continuously improve the customer experience.
  
  
**Here's a more detailed description of what you will do in this role:**
**Client Engagement**

* Own the overall health and success of a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring strong adoption, satisfaction, retention, and long-term value.
* Build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders and act as a strategic advisor on customer objectives and platform usage.
* Lead QBRs, health checks, success planning, and key customer conversations to understand evolving needs and drive measurable outcomes.
* Proactively identify customer risks, address concerns, and build mitigation plans to strengthen customer relationships and renewal readiness.

**Project & Delivery Management**

* Drive customer onboarding, implementation, integrations, and adoption initiatives, ensuring effective coordination across customers and internal teams.
* Manage multiple customer engagements and cross-functional dependencies to ensure timely delivery and resolution of customer priorities.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams to drive customer initiatives and ensure effective execution.

**Business Acumen**

* Understand customer business objectives and translate them into opportunities to improve platform adoption, utilization, and ROI.
* Analyze customer health, usage, feedback, and engagement trends to identify risks, improvement opportunities, and areas for growth.
* Identify expansion opportunities and partner with Customer Success and Sales teams to support account growth and long-term customer value.
* Capture customer feedback and translate recurring needs and business challenges into actionable inputs for relevant internal teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Understand the customer's technical architecture and integration setup well enough to have credible conversations with technical stakeholders.
* Maintain/contribute to troubleshooting guides, implementation docs, and RCAs. Owning the documentation of all projects involved in.
* Partner with Engineering/SRE to drive resolution of complex technical escalations, translating root cause into business impact and next steps for the customer.
* Own complex technical escalations by analyzing logs, debugging issues, and partner with Engineering and Product teams to diagnose issues, drive resolution, and ensure effective communication with customers.

**Solutioning & AI**

* Recommend platform configurations, workflows, integrations, and best practices that address customer requirements and improve business outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to leverage Kapture's automation and AI capabilities to improve customer experience, adoption, and operational efficiency.
* Work with Product and technical teams to translate customer requirements into scalable solutions and product improvements.
* Identify recurring customer challenges and contribute to scalable solutions rather than addressing issues individually.

**People Management**

* Mentor and support Customer Experience team members by sharing customer management, technical troubleshooting, and platform best practices.
* Support the team in managing complex customer situations and contribute to building stronger customer-facing capabilities.

**What does success look like in this role?**
Success in this role means customers consistently realize measurable value from Kapture's platform, demonstrate strong adoption and engagement, and maintain healthy long-term relationships with Kapture.
  
  
You build trusted relationships across business and technical stakeholders, proactively resolve customer risks, deliver customer initiatives effectively, and use technical and business insights to improve customer outcomes. You also contribute to retention, account growth, and scalable solutions that improve the overall customer experience.
  
  
**What would make you a good fit for this role?**
**Basic Requirements**

* You have 5 - 7 years of experience in fast paced, complex, growth environments in Customer Success, Customer Experience, Technical Account Management, Solution Consulting, or Enterprise SaaS.
* You have experience managing enterprise customers across business and technical stakeholders.
* You have a strong understanding of customer lifecycle management, onboarding, adoption, retention, and stakeholder management.
* You have experience working with APIs, integrations, troubleshooting, and enterprise SaaS implementations.
* You have experience managing multiple Enterprise SaaS customer engagements in the geography and working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Support teams.
* You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to balance customer, business, and technical priorities.

**You Will Have An Advantage If You**

* Have exposure to AI-powered CX, conversational AI, chatbots, or automation platforms.
* Have experience with CRM platforms such as Salesforce or HubSpot.
* Have experience creating customer playbooks, implementation guides, dashboards, campaign management, troubleshooting documentation, and RCAs.
* Have experience identifying recurring customer issues and driving preventive or scalable solutions.
* Have experience identifying and supporting account expansion opportunities.
* Have experience with dashboarding, APIs, integration frameworks, SQL/NoSQL databases or data flows, tools such as Kafka, Grafana, or similar monitoring platforms.

title: NewPage - Technical Principal - AI Solutions
description:
**Job Description :**
Tech Principal, AI Solutions. Location : Hybrid | Type : Full-time.
  
  
**About Newpage Solutions**
Newpage Solutions is a global digital health innovation company helping people live longer, healthier lives. We partner with life sciences organizations, including pharmaceutical, biotech, and healthcare leaders, to build transformative AI and data-driven technologies addressing real-world health challenges. From strategy and research to UX design and agile development, we deliver and validate impactful solutions using lean, human-centered practices. We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified for three consecutive years, hold a top Glassdoor rating, and were named among the "Top 50 Most Promising Healthcare Solution Providers" by CIOReview. We foster creativity, continuous learning, and inclusivity, creating an environment where bold ideas thrive and make a measurable difference in people's lives.
  
  
**Your Mission**
We are hiring a Tech Principal to work directly with our VP of Technology and the AI Center of Excellence. This is the role that shapes what we build, sets the bar for how we build it, and makes sure every AI engagement we take on lands well. The role carries three mandates. First, solution shaping : when a client brings a problem, an opportunity, or a half-formed requirement, you turn it into a crisp problem statement, a "what we heard" narrative, a solution architecture, a working prototype, and a user journey, and you present it back and shape the engagement plan. Second, engineering excellence : you work with capability leads to define and raise the AI-native standard across fullstack development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering. Third, delivery governance : you steer, review, and unblock every AI application and platform project we run so teams ship high-quality software predictably.
  
  
You treat AI as the substrate of how software gets built : not a tool to be cautious of, not something you are "exploring," but the medium you work in. You live at the current edge of AI development and work fluently with Claude Code, Cursor, agents, eval harnesses, MCP, and modern TypeScript and Python.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Shape Solutions in Discovery :
* Sit with client business, product, and clinical leaders when a problem or opportunity is still forming, and reframe it into a concrete, scoped problem statement in the room.
* Build the "what we understood" narrative that plays the client's problem back to them sharper than they framed it, and earns the right to propose the solution.
* Design the solution end-to-end : target architecture, user flows and journeys, data and integration boundaries, and the riskiest assumptions to validate first.
* Architect cloud-native, enterprise-grade solutions against explicit targets for performance, accuracy, latency, cost, security, and reliability, with infrastructure chosen for fit, not preference.
* Communicate architecture visually : layered architecture diagrams, sequence and data-flow diagrams, and user journeys that client executives and engineers can both read.
* Build working prototypes in days, not weeks, and demo them live without a slide deck.
* Shape the engagement plan with delivery leadership : team shape, phasing, milestones, and the commercial narrative that supports it.
* Lead POCs, innovation sprints, and research experiments to validate emerging AI techniques before they get baked into proposals or platform decisions.
* Set the Engineering Standards :
* Work with capability leads to define, document, and continuously raise AI-native standards across fullstack application development, agentic engineering, QA, DevSecOps, and data engineering.
* Codify how we build : reference architectures, Claude Code skills and sub-agents, templates, eval harnesses, and structured AI-assisted development workflows that every pod can adopt.
* Author ADRs, standards documents, and scope memos that hold up under review, covering LLM abstractions, retrieval design, vendor selection, integration boundaries, and infrastructure paths.
* Run architecture and design reviews across engagements, and make sure decisions are consistent, deliberate, and written down.
* Mentor senior engineers and capability leads on system design, agentic patterns, and AI engineering practice, and grow the next set of solution shapers.
* Govern and Steer Delivery :
* Own technical governance across all AI application and platform projects : regular architecture and quality reviews, risk surfacing, and early intervention when a project drifts.
* Define the quality gates that matter, including evals, test coverage, security posture (RBAC, audit trails), reliability, observability, and cost, and hold teams to them without slowing them down.
* Engage client enterprise architecture and security review paths early when they apply, and move with them, not around them.
* Unblock teams directly : get into the codebase, pair on the hard problem, and make the call when a team is stuck between options.
* Keep delivery, client, and leadership views aligned on where each project genuinely stands.
* Feed lessons from delivery back into standards, so every project makes the next one better.

**What You Bring**

* 7+ years of engineering experience, with architecture-level ownership on multiple production systems and at least 3 years building LLM-powered and agentic applications end-to-end.
* A consulting or client-facing solutioning background : you have shaped engagements from ambiguous conversations, won technical confidence in the room, and carried trade-off discussions with business leadership without locking them in.
* Direct hands-on experience designing and shipping LLM-powered products : RAG pipelines, prompt and context engineering, eval harnesses, and vendor-agnostic LLM abstractions.
* Hands-on experience with agents, not just prompted models : you have wired tools to a model and let it run multi-step using LangGraph, AutoGen, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants, or your own orchestration.
* Strong Python or TypeScript, with OOP, SOLID, 12-factor application development, and microservice architecture. You have built Next.js applications, FastAPI services, and similar.
* Active, structured use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) with demonstrable workflows, sub-agents, skills, and templates.
* Working fluency across the capabilities you will set standards for : QA and test automation, DevSecOps, and data engineering. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in each, but you must speak each language credibly and know what good looks like.
* Experience designing and deploying cloud-native architectures on AWS with Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions. Cloudflare experience a plus.
* Experience governing or assuring delivery across multiple concurrent teams : technical oversight, quality gates, and steering without micromanaging.
* Strong written communication : you author ADRs, standards, scope memos, and decision documents that hold up under review.
* Storytelling craft : you turn discovery conversations into narratives that make clients see their own problem more clearly, and you present architectures and live demos to executive audiences with confidence.
* A real, recent trail of built things : GitHub, a portfolio, side projects, indie tools, or OSS contributions.
* A no-compromise attitude on clean code, TDD, security, reliability, observability, scalability, performance, and cost.
* A founder's mindset and genuine appetite for ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges.

**Bonus Skills / Experience**

* Prior Tech Principal, Principal Consultant, Solution Architect, or Field CTO experience at a consultancy.
* Public writing, talks, or threads about building with AI.
* LLMOps and observability experience (LangSmith, Langfuse, Arize Phoenix), and model serving where the problem calls for it (Bedrock, SageMaker, vLLM).
* Streaming and batch ingestion pipelines (Spark, Airflow, Beam, Glue).
* Experience with enterprise AI governance frameworks (EU AI Act readiness, internal AI policy and risk frameworks).
* Pharma, healthcare, or other regulated-industry experience.
* Relevant cloud architecture certifications.

**What We Offer**
At Newpage, we're building a company that works smart and grows with agility, where driven individuals come together to do work that matters. We offer :
  
  

* A people-first culture : supportive peers, open communication, and a strong sense of belonging.
* Smart, purposeful collaboration : work with talented colleagues to create technologies that solve meaningful business challenges.
* Balance that lasts : we respect your time and support a healthy integration of work and life.
* Room to grow : opportunities for learning, leadership, and career development, shaped around you.
* Meaningful rewards : competitive compensation that recognizes both contribution and potential.

title: FAE Director
description:

**About Supermicro**

Our unprecedented global expansion has provided us with the opportunity to offer a large number of new positions to the technology community. title: Creative Strategist
description:
**About Iblix Digital**

Iblix Digital is a Kolkata-based performance marketing and UGC production agency. We've worked with 200+ clients since 2023, including Boldfit, Milton, Godrej, Fuel Shoes and Helios, and we shoot everything in our in-house studio.

**The role**

You take a client's brief all the way to a finished, high-performing ad: strategy, scripts, content calendar, studio shoot, and post production.

**Key responsibilities**

* **Client coordination:**
  Be the day-to-day contact for a set of D2C brands. Run onboarding, turn inputs into briefs, manage approvals and timelines.
* **Creative strategy and Meta ads:**
  Plan angles, hooks and formats. Research competitors on the Ad Library. Use ad data (hook rate, CTR, CPA, ROAS) with the performance team to decide what to test next.
* **Scriptwriting:**
  Write UGC, ad and Reel scripts in English, Hindi and Hinglish, with strong hooks, multiple hook variations and clear CTAs.
* **Social media and content calendar:**
  Plan monthly calendars, write captions, schedule posts and report on organic performance.
* **Production direction:**
  Plan and direct shoots in our studio: shot lists, props, casting and briefing creators, managing the studio calendar.
* **Team coordination:**
  Brief cinematographers and editors, review cuts, and track every deliverable from script to delivery.

**What we're looking for**

**Must have**

* 1–2 years at a agency, D2C brand or UGC/content production house
* A portfolio of scripts and ad creatives, ideally with results.
* A strong grasp of what makes a ad perform.
* Excellent English and Hindi/Hinglish writing
* Hands-on experience running shoots and directing talent
* Strong client communication and organisation across multiple brands
* Able to work on-site in Newtown.

**Good to have:**
basic editing (CapCut or Canva), camera and lighting basics, a network of Kolkata UGC creators.

**Why join Iblix**

Work with 40+ fast-growing D2C brands, own the full creative journey from script to results, work directly with the founders, and grow into Creative Head / Head of Production.

**How to apply**

Email hr@iblixdigital.com and CC- sangita@iblixdigital.com with the subject
**"Creative Strategist – [Your Name]"**
and include your CV, portfolio links, one ad you made that performed well (and why), your current and expected CTC, and your notice period.

Shortlisted candidates will get a short assignment.

description:

Job Description: Conversion SME (Manager)
  
  
**Position Title:**
Manager – Conversion Subject Matter Expert (Life Insurance & Annuities Policy Administration Transformation)
  
  
**Function:**
Insurance
  
  
**Location:**
Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Conversion SME will own the end-to-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life & Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
**Conversion Strategy & Governance**

* Define the end-to-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big-bang vs. phased/wave-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.

**Business & Technical Bridge**

* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source-of-truth calculations.
* Lead root-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.

**Data Mapping & Rules Definition**

* Author functional specifications for field-level, transaction-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims-in-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.

**Testing & Reconciliation**

* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy-level and aggregate-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.

**Team & Stakeholder Management**

* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.

**Compliance & Risk**

* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.

Must-Have Skills
  
  
**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
9
  
  
**Platform**
Hands-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
  
  
**Conversion-specific**
Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
  
  
**Data**
Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
  
  
**Documentation**
Ability to write field-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting-grade standards
  
  
**Delivery**
Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
  
  
**Regulatory**
Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion
  
  
**Preferred Skills**

* Prior Big 4/IT Service Company or systems integrator consulting background
* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)
* Exposure to agile delivery frameworks (Scrum/SAFe) in a conversion pod context
* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross-domain flexibility)
* Vendor-side experience (e.g., having worked at a FAST/Majesco/FINEOS implementation partner)

**Credentials/Certifications (Preferred, Not Mandatory)**

* LOMA certifications relevant to conversion/operations
* CSPO® / PMP® / Prosci (change management) for delivery-side credibility
* Platform-specific certifications (FAST, Majesco, FINEOS) where available

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Climate Resilience and Adaptation Advisor
description:
****Opportunity Type:****
Regular Fixed Term (Fixed Term)
  
  
****Summary:****
Position Summary
  
  
The Climate Resilience Advisor provides technical and advisory support to strengthen climate resilience of Habitat for Humanity’s housing and settlement work across Asia Pacific programs. The Advisor will work with the Asia-Pacific regional team to support Country Offices. This will include the implementation of strategic guidance, provision of technical assistance, design and delivery of capacity strengthening, supporting research, evidence-based implementation and knowledge management, advocacy and partnership development. This will include coordination with HFHI Global Program Operations, and specifically the Director-Climate Resilience (e.g., on development and implementation of the Global Climate Approach). The Advisor will work to ensure the integration of climate adaptation and mitigation into housing and settlement work and community development initiatives.
  
  
The Advisor will serve as the regional focal point for climate action, and in this capacity will support Country Offices to understand climate risks, and options to address/mitigate these risks to reduce vulnerability and build resilience of low- and middle-income households and communities across the Asia Pacific region.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities:****
**Key Result Areas and Responsibilities**

* Strategic Alignment and Stakeholder Engagement (30%)

Provide technical thought leadership to ensure climate resilient housing and settlement programming is aligned with the Global Climate Approach, with contextualized implementation across Country Offices in Asia Pacific region.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Provide technical leadership to support contextualized/localized implementation and monitoring of HFHI’s Global Climate Approach within the Asia Pacific region.
* Advise on current/recent sources of climate risk data and analyses, and options for integrating climate these risks into housing/settlement-focused project design, implementation and monitoring.
* Facilitate alignment and promote integration between climate resilience programming and broader disaster risk reduction/humanitarian programming.
* Serve as a technical resource and thought partner to Habitat Country Offices, supporting program design, implementation and learning.
* Engage with external stakeholders (HFHI’s global and regional partners, research institutions, NGOs, and networks) to strengthen technical positioning and partnerships opportunities around climate resilience and DRR.
* Represent HFHI and contribute to relevant regional and global forums, working groups, and coordination platforms, as required.
* Support strategic partnerships and collaboration opportunities that advance Habitat's climate resilience agenda.
* Capacity Building and Technical Support (25%)

Strengthen the technical capacity of Country Offices and partners to design, implement, and scale high-quality climate resilience housing/settlement programming
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
Assess in-country capacity, design and facilitate targeted capacity building initiatives (e.g., structured training, workshops, coaching) for National Organization staff on climate resilience.
  
  
Develop and maintain technical resources, tools, guidance documents, and learning materials.
  
  
Facilitate communities of practice, peer learning, and regional exchanges.
  
  
Promote organizational learning across countries, programs and operations.
  
  

* Technical Program Oversight (25%)

Provide advisory support to Country Offices to help ensure the quality of climate-related program design, implementation and monitoring. considerations into program designs, projects—supporting Country Offices to scale impact, and cross-learning across the Asia Pacific Region.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Provide technical input and advisory support to Country Offices to strengthen integration of climate risk data/analyses and evidenced-based approaches into climate resilient housing/settlements project design, implementation and monitoring.
* Advise Country Offices on context specific adaptation measures, including resilient construction techniques, site selection, safer land use, and community-based approaches.
* Where feasible, advise Country Offices on context appropriate mitigation measures, where feasible,
* Contribute technical input to concept notes, program proposals, and donor reports related to climate resilience (e.g., adaptation and mitigation).
* As requested, support donor engagement resource mobilization efforts.
* Collaborate with other Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) and technical teams to ensure climate considerations are integrated into cross-sectoral programming.
* Research, Innovation, Learning and Knowledge Management (15%)

Strengthen evidence generation, cross-learning and innovation, to improve climate resilient housing/settlement programming and support scaling of effective approaches.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Support research design and implementation, the generation and synthesis of evidence, and institutional learning specific to climate resilient housing.
* Document and share climate resilient housing/settlement promising practices, case studies, and lessons learned.
* Contribute to integration of climate and DRR indicators into MEAL systems and contribute to regional and global learning agendas.
* Contribute to research, support innovation pilots, and partnerships related to climate resilient housing and settlements.
* Develop and disseminate technical resources, and guidance materials.
* Provide subject matter expertise and technical advisory support to other departments and initiatives within HFHI.
* Disaster Preparedness, Response and Recovery Support (5%)

Provide advisory support to integrate climate risk reduction and resilience into disaster preparedness, response and recovery efforts
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
Work with the Housing Disaster Risk and Resilience (HDRR) team on climate risk reduction measures in response and recovery
  
  
Provide technical input on risk-informed approaches to recovery planning and implementation
  
  
Support alignment of recovery interventions with long-term resilience objectives
  
  
****Required Qualifications & Experience****

* Master’s degree in Climate Change, Environmental Sciences, Disaster Risk Reduction, Urban Planning, Engineering, Development Studies, or a related field
* Minimum 5–7 years of relevant experience in climate resilience, DRR, or risk-informed programming, preferably in the Asia-Pacific region
* Demonstrated experience supporting multi-country programs and working with decentralized teams
* Strong understanding of climate risks, adaptation, and resilience approaches in housing, settlements, or community development
* Strong understanding of climate risks, adaptation, resilience, and mitigation approaches in housing, settlements, infrastructure, or community development.
* Experience in humanitarian, recovery, or nexus programming is an asset
* Experience in donor engagement, proposal development, or climate finance is an advantage

****Key Skills & Competencies****

* Strong technical expertise in climate adaptation and the built environment
* Sound understanding of climate mitigation, with the ability to understand where synergies and tradeoffs exist between mitigation and adaptation (especially where these impact affordability)
* Ability to translate technical concepts into practical, field-oriented guidance
* Proven advisory, facilitation, and capacity-building skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English (regional languages an asset)
* Strong cross-cultural collaboration skills and ability to work in matrixed environments
* Willingness and ability to travel within the Asia-Pacific region

**Core Behavioral Competencies**

* Commitment to HFHI’s mission, values, equity, and safeguarding principles
* Collaboration and partnership mindset
* Learning oriented and solution focused
* Accountability and integrity

**Working Conditions**

* Regional role with frequent collaboration across multiple countries and time zones.
* Periodic travel to Country Offices and Country Offices, including fragile, climate-vulnerable, and disaster-affected contexts.
* Ability and willingness to travel within the Asia-Pacific region as required.

****About Us:****
Habitat for Humanity, founded in 1976, is a global, Christian-based nonprofit organization that grew out of an intentionally multi-racial community in rural Georgia. Seeking to put God’s love into action, Habitat brings together people of all faiths and people of no faith to build homes, communities and hope. Working alongside each other, we help families and individuals build and improve places to call home and achieve the strength, stability and self-reliance they need to build better lives for themselves. Habitat seeks individuals who have a willingness to affirm these principles and values.
  
  
At Habitat for Humanity International, we are compelled by our Koinonia roots to put God’s love for all into action and pursue housing equity and opportunity by bringing all people together to build community and drive impact. We strive to build a culture rooted in learning, accountability and trust, attracting and retaining mission-driven talent reflective of the global communities we serve.

title: Associate Director- Protection & Control
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Jacobs is a global provider of technical, professional, and scientific services including engineering, architecture, construction, operations, and project management. Our portfolio spans industrial, commercial, and government clients across multiple markets and geographies. We have a PAN-India presence, with world-class engineering delivery centres in Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune, Chennai and Kolkata.
  
  
Challenging Today…Reinventing Tomorrow.
  
  
Jacobs is seeking a
**Associate Director- Protection & Control**
to support a range of high-profile projects across our Power & Energy portfolio. In this role, you will serve as a global Subject Matter Expert – Protection & Control, IEC 61850 & Digital Substations providing advanced technical leadership for protection and control engineering across substations, transmission and distribution systems, renewable interconnections, industrial power networks and digital grid infrastructure.
  
  
The SME will act as a technical authority for conventional, hybrid and fully digital substations, supporting projects across global markets including UK, Australia, Middle East, Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific. The role requires deep domain expertise in protection schemes, relay settings, substation automation, IEC 61850 integration, SCADA interfaces, cybersecurity, commissioning support and future-ready digital substation technologies.
  
  
**The Primary Responsibilities Would Be**
**Protection & Control Engineering**

* Provide specialist technical leadership for protection and control design of medium voltage, high voltage and extra high voltage substations.
* Lead, review and technically assure protection schemes for

+ Line protection
+ Transformer protection
+ Busbar protection
+ Breaker failure protection
+ Feeder protection
+ Capacitor bank and reactor protection
+ SVC / STATCOM protection
+ Renewable and BESS interconnection protection
+ Industrial power network protection
+ Grid connection and interconnection protection

* Lead and review key engineering deliverables including

+ Protection Single Line Diagrams / Key Line Diagrams
+ Protection and control schematics
+ Control logic diagrams
+ Trip and alarm matrix
+ AC/DC auxiliary schematics
+ Panel GA and BOQ
+ Wiring diagrams
+ Interface drawings
+ Interconnection schedules
+ Cable schedules
+ Relay assembled forms
+ Test and commissioning documentation

* Provide expert review of relay setting calculations and protection coordination studies.
* Review and approve relay settings, protection philosophies, technical reports and protection coordination documents.
* Provide technical direction for distance protection, differential protection, overcurrent protection, earth fault protection, REF, synchro-check, auto-reclose, breaker failure and busbar protection applications.
* Support fault level studies, protection grading, grid code compliance and system performance validation.
* Provide technical support during FAT, SAT, commissioning, energization and post-energization troubleshooting.
* Review vendor drawings, relay configuration files, test procedures, test reports and as-built documentation.

**IEC 61850 Integration and Digital Substations**

* Lead advanced engineering for IEC 61850-based digital substations, including concept design, detailed design, configuration strategy, integration, testing and commissioning support.
* Define and review complete digital substation architecture including

+ Station bus
+ Process bus
+ Protection IEDs
+ Merging units
+ SCADA gateways
+ HMI systems
+ Engineering workstations
+ Network switches
+ Time synchronization systems

* Provide expert guidance on IEC 61850 applications including

+ GOOSE messaging
+ MMS communication
+ Sampled Values
+ Logical nodes and data modelling
+ Dataset configuration
+ Report control blocks
+ GOOSE control blocks
+ Sampled Value control blocks
+ Multi-vendor interoperability

* Lead preparation and review of IEC 61850 deliverables including

+ IEC 61850 architecture drawings
+ Communication architecture
+ IED capability assessment
+ Signal lists and data point schedules
+ GOOSE mapping schedules
+ MMS mapping schedules
+ Sampled Value design documents
+ Logical node mapping
+ ICD, CID, IID, SCD and SSD file review records
+ FAT/SAT procedures for IEC 61850 systems

* Provide expert review and validation of IEC 61850 configuration files and ensure consistency between drawings, relay configuration, automation configuration and SCADA mapping.
* Lead or support multi-vendor integration involving Siemens, Hitachi Energy / ABB, GE Vernova, Schneider Electric, SEL, NR Electric and other global OEMs.
* Support digital substation testing using tools such as Omicron, Doble, Wireshark, IEDScout, StationScout, IET600, DIGSI 5, PCM600, EnerVista and equivalent platforms.
* Guide project teams on migration from conventional hardwired systems to hybrid or fully digital substation architecture.
* Develop digital substation templates, standard architectures, reusable design libraries and configuration governance processes.

**Substation Automation, SCADA and Communication Networks**

* Provide technical leadership for substation automation systems, SCADA integration, RTU/Gateway interfaces, HMI systems and control centre communication.
* Review communication protocols and interfaces including IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-101/104, IEC 60870-5-103, DNP3, Modbus, OPC UA, SNMP and synchrophasor interfaces where applicable.
* Lead design and review of digital substation communication networks including

+ Ethernet LAN architecture
+ Managed switch configuration philosophy
+ VLANs and IP addressing
+ Multicast management
+ PRP / HSR redundancy
+ Network segmentation
+ Remote engineering access
+ Network monitoring and diagnostics

* Provide guidance on time synchronization systems including IEEE 1588 PTP, SNTP, IRIG-B and GPS-based time sources.
* Review communication architecture for high availability, resilience and reliable operation of critical protection and control systems.

**Cybersecurity Considerations**

* Provide technical leadership on cybersecurity requirements for protection, control, automation and digital substation systems.
* Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across the engineering lifecycle from concept design through commissioning and handover.
* Review designs against relevant cybersecurity standards and requirements such as IEC 62351, IEC 62443, NERC CIP where applicable, utility standards and client-specific cybersecurity requirements.
* Provide guidance on secure substation architecture including

+ Network segmentation
+ Defense-in-depth design
+ Secure remote access
+ Role-based access control
+ User authentication
+ Password and credential management
+ Firewall and gateway interface requirements
+ Secure engineering access
+ Logging and event monitoring
+ Asset inventory
+ Patch and firmware management considerations
+ Backup and recovery strategy
+ Configuration file control
+ IED, gateway, HMI and workstation hardening

* Define cybersecurity requirements for vendors and OEMs during specification, procurement, FAT, SAT and commissioning stages.
* Support cybersecurity risk reviews for IEC 61850 systems, SCADA links, remote access, vendor interfaces and third-party equipment.
* Promote secure-by-design principles for digital substations, renewable plants and future grid automation systems.

**Renewable Energy, Grid Connection And Future Capabilities**

* Provide SME support for solar, wind, battery energy storage, hybrid renewable plants, collector substations and grid interconnection facilities.
* Support protection design for inverter-based resources, weak grids, low fault current networks and changing grid behaviour.
* Provide technical guidance on grid code compliance for renewable interconnections across different countries and regions.
* Support future capability development in

+ Digital substations
+ Process bus implementation
+ Centralized protection systems
+ Virtual protection and control concepts
+ Wide Area Monitoring, Protection and Control
+ Synchrophasor-based applications
+ Digital twin for substations
+ Model-based engineering
+ Automated relay setting workflows
+ AI-assisted engineering checks
+ Cloud-based asset monitoring
+ Predictive maintenance
+ Cyber-secure remote commissioning
+ Standardized global digital substation delivery models

**Technical Assurance, Quality and Delivery**

* Act as the highest level of technical support for complex protection, control, automation and digital substation issues.
* Provide independent technical review, design assurance and quality validation for critical deliverables.
* Ensure engineering outputs comply with client specifications, utility standards, grid codes, IEC, IEEE, CIGRE recommendations, regional requirements and Jacobs quality procedures.
* Support project execution plans, design criteria, risk registers, assurance plans and quality review processes.
* Support resolution of client queries, technical deviations, design changes, non-conformances and site issues.
* Work with Design Project Engineers, Project Managers and global delivery teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to expected quality standards.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of technical, commercial, schedule, risk, HSEC and quality aspects of projects.

**Client, Proposal and Capability Development**

* Lead technical discussions with clients, utilities, OEMs, contractors and global project teams.
* Support proposals, bids, tenders, technical estimates, capability statements and technical bid evaluations.
* Manage technical relationships and build appropriate level contacts with key clients.
* Strengthen client relationships through technical excellence, practical problem solving and high-quality project delivery.
* Mentor Lead Engineers, Senior Engineers, Graduate Engineers and design teams.
* Develop internal capability through training, technical sessions, lessons learned and knowledge sharing.
* Create and maintain technical standards, design guides, checklists, templates, automation workflows and best-practice documents.
* Drive innovation, digital delivery, standardization and future-ready engineering practices across the Protection & Control discipline.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* BE / B Tech / ME / M Tech in Electrical Engineering.
* Minimum 18+ years of experience in Protection & Control engineering, substation automation, digital substations or associated power system engineering.
* Strong experience in MV, HV and EHV substation protection and control systems.
* Experience with substations up to 400kV / 765kV and above is desirable.
* Proven experience supporting international utility, renewable, industrial and grid connection projects.
* Expert knowledge of protection philosophies, relay applications, control systems, SCADA integration, substation automation and digital substation technologies.
* Strong experience in IEC 61850 design, configuration review, integration, testing and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity requirements for protection, automation and digital substation systems.
* Ability to interpret international standards, utility requirements, client specifications and grid codes.
* Excellent technical report writing, communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to act as a global technical authority, mentor teams and support capability growth across the business.

**Mandatory Skill Sets**

* Expert-level knowledge of Protection & Control engineering for substations, T&D systems, renewable interconnections and industrial power networks.
* Strong knowledge of protection schemes, relay setting calculations, relay configuration, protection coordination and testing.
* Advanced knowledge of IEC 61850 including station bus, process bus, GOOSE, MMS, Sampled Values, logical nodes, datasets, control blocks and SCD file management.
* Strong understanding of digital substation architecture, IED integration, communication networks and multi-vendor interoperability.
* Strong awareness of cybersecurity standards and secure-by-design principles.
* Strong technical assurance, quality review and independent design checking capability.
* Ability to lead complex technical discussions with clients, utilities, OEMs and global project teams.
* Experience supporting FAT, SAT, commissioning and troubleshooting of protection, control and digital substation systems.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to articulate clear technical direction.

**Preferred Skill Sets**

* Experience with tools such as DIGSI 5, PCM600, EnerVista, Easergy Studio, AcSELerator, IET600, Omicron Test Universe, StationScout, IEDScout, Doble and Wireshark.
* Experience with AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, MicroStation, ETAP, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD or PSS/E.
* Experience in Australia, UK, Middle East, Europe, US or other international utility projects.
* Experience in solar, wind, BESS, hybrid renewable plants and grid interconnection projects.
* Experience with IEC 62351, IEC 62443, NERC CIP or utility cybersecurity frameworks.
* Knowledge of PRP, HSR, VLANs, multicast traffic management, PTP, SNTP, IRIG-B and network resilience requirements.
* Experience in model-based engineering, digital twin, automation workflows or data-centric engineering delivery.
* Basic understanding of Python or scripting for engineering process improvement is preferred.

**We welcome applications from qualified professionals currently based overseas who are open to relocating to India. Relocation support may be provided for exceptional candidates having extensive experience in
**delivering E&P infrastructure projects**
.**

To support your professional growth, Jacobs flexible working arrangements, extended leave options and a host of social, health and wellbeing events and initiatives will underpin our commitment to you.

**About The Role**
The LTE RAN RF Planning Engineer is reliable for monitoring, optimising, and maintaining the RF performance of a private LTE network and associated wireless technologies used to help mission critical mining operations. This includes ensuring consistent coverage, mobility, and capacity for self-governing haulage, fleet communications, IoT sensors, control systems, CCTV, rail operations, and Cambium point to multipoint (PTMP) / point to point (PTP) wireless links distributed across the mine.
  
  
The role focuses on operational RF optimisation, performance troubleshooting, and helping deployment or relocation of LTE cells and Cambium nodes in dynamic mining environments.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Manage incidents and requests while maintaining high ticket quality and hygiene.
* Develop RF propagation and coverage models for open-pit mine environments using tools such as HTZ, Atoll, Mentum, or similar.
* Perform advanced root cause analysis for LTE outages.
* Maintain and manage LTE macro/small cell hardware (FDD) suitable for dynamic mining operations.
* Perform frequency optimization, PCI/RSI planning, link budgets, interference analysis, and EARFCN/channel allocation.
* Create RAN capacity plans aligned with AHS (Autonomous Haulage System), telemetry, CCTV, and IoT demands.
* Provide remote guidance to field teams performing RF surveys, antenna alignment, and LTE trailer moves.
* Use TEMS Pocket / TEMS Discovery for drive test data analysis (onsite teams), RSRP/SINR profiling, Layer 3 message decoding, handover investigations, and KPI trend analysis.
* Analyse LTE RAN performance KPIs including throughput, PRB utilisation, accessibility, retainability, and mobility metrics.
* Identify and resolve issues such as overshooting, coverage holes, interference, and imbalance.
* Produce optimisation recommendations such as power adjustments, tilt optimisations, parameter changes, and azimuth
* Conduct remote troubleshooting sessions with onsite teams, providing step by step diagnostic guidance.
* Manage and optimise Cambium PTP/PTMP backhaul links using tools such as Cambium HTZ/ LINKPlanner.
* Perform path profile studies, Fresnel zone checks, and availability modelling.
* Provide remote alignment assistance and configuration guidance to site teams.
* Work with Mining Technology, AHS, Fleet Management, and OT Automation teams to understand coverage/performance needs, adjust designs for pit progression and mine expansion, and ensure stable connectivity for trucks, drills, shovels, LV, and IoT devices
* Provide remote RF design updates as mine topology changes
* Provide remote RF design updates as mine topology changes.
* Prepare RF design documents, coverage heatmaps, network design packs, BOMs, and commissioning documentation.
* Support acceptance and integration testing remotely.
* Maintain version-controlled RF documents and change logs.
* Design LTE and wireless systems for high reliability in remote industrial environments.
* Ensure designs comply with mining standards, cybersecurity requirements, and operational safety guidelines.
* Consider resilience, redundancy, and harsh environmental factors when developing plans.
* Manage and upkeep of NetAct server and software.

**Technical Skills Needed**

* Minimum 3–5+ years of LTE RAN planning, RF engineering, or optimisation experience.
* Experience with Private LTE / 5G SA networks in industrial deployments.
* Experience with common GIS applications eg: Global mapper,ArcGIS
* Knowledge of mining technologies (AHS, fleet management, dispatch systems).
* Networking knowledge: VLANs, routing, backhaul design, QoS.
* Scripting or automation (Python, SQL) for performance reporting is advantageous.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.

Rotational shifts of 24x7
  
  

* Preferred:
* LTE/RAN certification (nokia,Ericsson,Cisco)
* Cambium certification desirable
* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or related field.

**Essential Skills / Experience**

* Strong understanding of LTE RAN concepts (EPC/E-UTRAN architecture, PCI planning, SINR/RSRP/TA, VoLTE, CA, etc.).
* Hands on experience analysing drive test data using TEMS Investigation or TEMS Discovery.
* Experience with RF planning tools (Atoll, HTZ, Planet, Mentum, iBwave).
* Experience with Cambium Networks (PTP 670/700, PMP 450i/450m,CnMaestro, cnWave, etc.).
* Strong analytical background in interpreting logs, KPIs, layer 3 messages, and RF statistics.
* Experience in ticketing-tools like Service Now, and exposure to ITIL processes in context of service operations is a plus.
* Experience supporting remote sites (mining/oil & gas/utilities) is preferred.
* Ability to work effectively with field teams from a remote location.

title: SC Operations Specialist
description:
The
**Supply Chain Specialist**
is an operational role within the Supply Chain Operations team.
  
  
This position is responsible for the day-to-day execution and monitoring of the manufacturing and supply plan for
**Drug Substance (DS)**
,
**Drug Product (DP)**
, and
**Finished Packed Goods (FP)**
. The role ensures internal DS and DP manufacturing sites, as well as external CDMOs (for part of DP) and CMOs (for all packaging), deliver according to the plan received from Supply Chain Planning.
  
  
The specialist acts as a key operational coordinator and line-driver, maintaining visibility on supply status and supporting reliable product availability for patients.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Daily Execution & Monitoring of the Supply Plan Monitors daily and weekly progress of the manufacturing plan across DS (internal), DP (internal + CDMO), and FP packaging (CMOs). Tracks status against agreed timelines and quantities.
* Supply Status Tracking Maintains accurate, up-to-date visibility on production, inventory, and material movements for all DS, DP, and FP SKUs. Provides regular updates on where the company stands versus the manufacturing plan.
* Order Management & Delivery Follow-up Serves as a central point of contact for supply-related questions from internal and external stakeholders. Updates delivery dates in SAP, processes order changes, and ensures commitments are followed up in terms of quantity and timeline.
* Backorder & Bottleneck Management Tracks backorders, supports prioritization, and helps coordinate resolution of bottlenecks with internal manufacturing, CDMOs, CMOs, and other functions.
* KPI Tracking & Reporting Collects and consolidates data to support monitoring of key supply chain KPIs, including OTIF, backlog, backorder levels, lead time, MOQ adherence, and ADS. Prepares regular reports and dashboards as part of the Supply Chain Operations team.
* Meeting Participation Participates in demand control meetings and operational reviews with tactical planners. Provides updates on current supply status and KPI performance for specific products or delivery streams.
* Risk Identification & Escalation Monitors committed delivery dates versus actual progress. Flags potential delays or risks early and escalates supply issues to senior team members or relevant functions with supporting information.
* Stakeholder Coordination Works closely with internal DS/DP manufacturing sites, external CDMOs (DP), and CMOs (packaging) to ensure smooth execution of the supply plan. Supports communication and follow-up between Supply Chain Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, and Logistics teams.
* System & Data Management Maintains accurate data in SAP related to production orders, deliveries, and inventory. Supports month-end supply reconciliation activities.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Life Sciences, or a related field.
* 1–4 years of experience in supply chain, preferably in pharmaceuticals or biotech.
* Exposure to manufacturing supply chains (ideally DS/DP) and/or working with CDMOs/CMOs is a strong advantage.
* Basic knowledge of SAP (PP, MM, or SD modules) is preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong organizational and coordination skills.
* Good analytical skills with attention to detail.
* Clear communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and international environment.
* Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership.
* Fluency in English (additional languages are a plus).

* Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.

**Service Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
* Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.

* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.

* Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
* Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

**Data Quality & Continuous Improvement**

* Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
* Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
* Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.

title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Why should you apply to this role?**
The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large-scale Cloud migrations.
  
  
You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:**
Lead end-to-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
  
  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision-making through data-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support & engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.

**Industry Insight:**
Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
  
  
**Compensation**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Qualifications
  
  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior-level decision-makers and c-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.

**Benefits & Perks**
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**

At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.

captures information about the sample, requests for measurements, and follows its entire workflow through the lab, supervising manual operating procedures, automated instrument steps, and calculations until the final report.

**Application Engineer**

* University Degree in Life Sciences, Bioinformatics, Biotechnology, Chemistry, Computer Science, Scientific Informatics, or a related discipline (or alternatively solid relevant experience in this application engineering field)
* Hands-on laboratory experience in analytical chemistry, biobanks, pharma, biopharma, genomics, NGS, Academia, etc.
* Preferred experience with LIMS, ELN, LES, SDMS, CDS, laboratory automation, scientific software, or laboratory workflow management systems.
* You have knowledge of programming languages such as Java or Python with proven coding skills
* Experience working directly with customers, stakeholders, laboratory users, or cross-functional project teams is highly desirable.
* Full proficiency in English.

On a personal level, you possess great
**problem solving**
/
**analytical skills, and**
you are
**eager to learn**
about new software technology, instruments, applications, and consumables. You have
**communication/interpersonal skills**
to interact at various levels, and you strive to provide excellent customer support. You enjoy both
**working within a team**
and
**autonomously**
.
  
  
We will make sure
**you get all the training and development opportunities you need to become the best in your field!**
