title: Manager - Client Experience Support
description:
**Purpose**
As a Client Experience Support Manager, you will manage Client support staff members and the work they perform to support our clients. You will drive process and performance improvement to meet or exceed customer expectations. You will focus on the team to provide enthusiastic support, which includes analyzing root-cause issues and solutions rather than addressing transactional support issues and hold staff accountable to consistent process and improved performance.
  
  
**Clinisys' AI Philosophy**
Building an
**AI‑first organisation**
is central to Clinisys’ purpose and the impact we deliver. As a global provider of intelligent diagnostic informatics solutions, we build AI‑enabled, cloud‑based platforms to enhance diagnostic workflows across healthcare, life sciences, and public health. By applying intelligent technology thoughtfully and responsibly, we help laboratories and testing environments operate more effectively, generate meaningful insights at scale, and ultimately support healthier and safer communities. Operating across more than 42 countries, Clinisys expects all colleagues—regardless of role or function—to work confidently with AI‑enabled tools, apply digital and analytical thinking, and continuously adapt as technologies evolve. We
**must drive an AI-first sense of purpose and urgency.**
**Essential Functions**

* Manages performance of Client Support staff through mentoring, education, standard processes, client focus and metrics.
* Manage consistent metrics for the Client Support organization
* Daily, weekly and monthly reporting on organizational performance and productivity
* Measuring individual performance
* Monitor backlog and customer concerns trends to find root causes and provide solutions to processes and education/communication to all staff to implement changes.
* Drive continuous service improvement based on quality metrics and customer feedback. This would include management of customer concerns and service request management, including trend analysis and reporting.
* Responsible for planning and allocating resources to ensure team availability to resolve customer issues in a timely fashion.
* Responsible for developing strong business partnerships with other internal departments.
* Expected to recommend changes to products or services to fulfill customer needs and work with peers to refine and implement those changes.
* Responsible for supporting the organization by providing reference-able clients, providing client information and responding to inquiries from other areas of the organization.
* Accountable for talent development of direct staff to ensure adequate bench strength and succession planning including all employee related activities (i.e. hires, training, appraisals, rewards and recognition, and disciplinary action) including ongoing guidance, direction and mentoring
* Ability to be on-call on a rotational basis in a 24/7 environment
* All other duties and responsibilities as assigned

**Skills**

* Demonstrated ability to coach, develop and mentor.
* Positive problem-solving mentality, seeking solutions and process improvements to enhance performance
* Ability to perform detailed analysis, out of the box thinking to identify solutions.
* Demonstrate high level of organizational and communication skills required for all aspects of daily duties
* Proven ability to use AI and emerging technologies responsibly to enable more efficient, consistent, and scalable ways of working.

**Required Experience & Education**

* BA/BS Degree in Technology, Medical field or related degree
* 5-7 years’ experience in a product support environment
* Demonstrated experience with building business partnerships, improving client experience and happiness, process development and productivity improvement.
* 1-3 years’ supervisory/leadership experience

**Preferred Experience & Education**

* Familiarity with software development, lifecycles and technical support processes preferred.
* Exposure to the Healthcare or IT industry preferred.
* Formal Presentation skills preferred.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* 8-12 direct reports

**Physical Requirements**

* Work is performed in a typical office setting with minimal exposure to health or safety hazards—prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Less than 10% travel may be required to client sites that can pose risks associated with healthcare organizations.
* Moderate lifting/carrying 15-44 lbs.; use of fingers; walking/standing 2-6 hours
* May be required to follow customer location health and safety requirements.

Competent and goal-driven

Apply today!

title: Sr Service Support Coordinator
description:
**Overview**
Join a dynamic and customer-focused service organization where you will play a critical role in ensuring seamless coordination of field service activities and delivering an exceptional customer experience. As a Service Coordinator, you will work closely with customers, field engineers, and cross-functional teams to manage service operations, drive efficiency, and support the successful execution of service commitments. This is an exciting opportunity to be part of a collaborative, fast-paced environment where your organizational skills, problem-solving mindset, and ability to build strong relationships will directly contribute to customer success and operational excellence.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Monitor service orders from initiation through completion, proactively identifying and resolving scheduling, logistics, or operational issues to minimize delays and improve service performance.
* Collaborate with field engineers, service managers, and cross-functional teams to ensure efficient execution of service commitments and adherence to operational processes.
* Maintain accurate service records, documentation, and system updates, ensuring data integrity and providing visibility into service performance.
* Track key service metrics and generate reports to support operational reviews, identify improvement opportunities, and drive continuous process optimization.
* Support business objectives by ensuring compliance with company policies, safety standards, and quality requirements while contributing to a culture of operational excellence and teamwork.

**Qualifications**
Bachelor’s degree with 3-5+ years of experience in service coordination, field service operations, customer support, scheduling or a related operational role within a service-driven organization.
  
  
Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple service requests, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively interact with customers, field service engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  
  
Proficiency in ERP, CRM, and service management systems (e.g., SAP, Salesforce, ServiceMax, or similar tools), along with strong Microsoft Office skills.
  
  
Demonstrated problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a proactive approach to resolving scheduling, logistics, and customer service challenges.
  
  
Customer-focused mindset with strong attention to detail, data accuracy, teamwork, and a commitment to delivering high-quality service and operational excellence.
  
  
**Company Description**
Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of :16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.
  
  
Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our core values at Waters Corporation. It benefits our employees, our products, our customers and our community. Waters complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Waters is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

* Data Operations & Technical Oversight

+ Manage daily operation of batch and streaming data pipelines, including ingestion, transformation, scheduling, and delivery to downstream systems and reporting platforms.
+ Monitor job execution, data freshness, processing volumes, and dependencies; coordinate reruns, backfills, and recovery using approved procedures and reconciliation checks.
+ Maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures, job inventories, dependency maps, and escalation paths for supported data services.
+ Investigate pipeline failures, data discrepancies, and performance issues using logs, monitoring tools, and SQL; engage engineering teams where code or architecture changes are required.
+ Coordinate production changes and releases with engineering and DevOps teams, validating operational readiness, support handover, rollback procedures, and post-release checks.
+ Lead incident triage, business-impact assessment, escalation, and service restoration; coordinate root-cause analysis and track corrective actions to closure.

* Service Delivery & Operational Excellence

+ Plan and prioritize operational workloads, support requests, and improvement activities to meet agreed SLAs and critical business processing deadlines.
+ Implement incident, problem, change, and service request management practices; maintain effective shift handovers and on-call coverage where required by the service model.
+ Track and report pipeline success rates, data freshness, SLA adherence, incident volumes, recovery times, and recurring failures; use trends to improve service performance.
+ Automate repetitive checks, recovery steps, and reporting where appropriate; work with engineering teams to reduce manual effort, recurring incidents, and inefficient resource usage.
+ Operate data quality checks and source-to-target reconciliations; route exceptions to accountable data owners and maintain evidence of resolution, access reviews, and approved controls.

* Team Leadership & Talent Management

+ Manage a team of data operations analysts and support engineers, assigning responsibilities and ensuring appropriate coverage for supported services.
+ Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, service ownership, and disciplined execution, with clear expectations for operational quality.
+ Manage capacity planning, onboarding, performance feedback, and training; develop cross-skilling and backup coverage for critical processes.
+ Coach team members on troubleshooting, data validation, incident handling, documentation, and stakeholder communication.

* Business & Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with finance stakeholders, data owners, and reporting teams to understand data dependencies, business priorities, and critical reporting or period-close schedules.
+ Coordinate with data engineering, platform, security, and governance teams to resolve operational issues and maintain clear ownership across service boundaries.
+ Support onboarding of new data services by validating support requirements, monitoring coverage, runbooks, knowledge transfer, and acceptance criteria.
+ Communicate service status, incidents, business impact, recovery estimates, and improvement progress clearly to stakeholders and management.

* Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

+ Work with data owners to define and maintain operational checks for completeness, accuracy, validity, consistency, and timeliness of critical datasets.
+ Identify recurring data and process issues; maintain a prioritized improvement backlog and standardize reusable monitoring, reconciliation, and support practices.
+ Support backup and recovery validation, continuity exercises, and retention procedures with platform and governance teams; verify data integrity following restoration.

**Qualifications**
**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7+ years of experience in data operations, data engineering support, production support, or analytics operations, including responsibility for enterprise data services.
* 2+ years of team leadership or people-management experience, with a track record of coordinating operational delivery and developing support teams.

**Technical Expertise**

* Hands-on experience supporting data workloads on at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS, or GCP), including monitoring, troubleshooting, and access controls.
* Strong SQL skills and understanding of ETL/ELT processes, relational databases, data warehouses, and data lake or lakehouse environments.
* Experience with data orchestration and processing tools relevant to the environment (e.g., Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Spark, dbt, or Kafka), including failure diagnosis and recovery.
* Working knowledge of Python or shell scripting, APIs, file-based integrations, logging, and monitoring tools to automate checks and investigate data flow issues.
* Understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, role-based access, sensitive-data handling, and enterprise governance requirements.

**Operational & Delivery Skills**

* Proven ability to manage production data services against SLAs, prioritize incidents by business impact, and coordinate effective service restoration.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management, release support, runbooks, and root-cause analysis; familiarity with ITIL, DevOps, or DataOps practices.
* Ability to interpret operational metrics, identify performance and capacity issues, and coordinate improvements with engineering and platform teams.

**Domain & Functional Knowledge**

* Exposure to corporate finance processes (P2P, O2C, R2R, and FP&A), finance data flows, and the importance of timely and accurate reporting is preferred.
* Experience supporting finance transformation, ERP-connected data pipelines, analytics platforms, or period-end reporting operations is highly desirable.

**Leadership & Behavioral Skills**

* Strong team supervision, workload planning, coaching, and collaboration skills.
* Clear stakeholder communication, including the ability to explain incidents, business impact, and resolution progress to non-technical audiences.
* Ability to remain organized under pressure, apply structured problem-solving, and balance hands-on troubleshooting with effective delegation.
* High ownership mindset focused on data reliability, service quality, timely escalation, and continuous improvement.

title: Project Manager- Interior
description:
At Turner & Townsend we’re passionate about making the difference. That means delivering better outcomes for our clients, helping our people to realize their potential, and doing our part to create a prosperous society.

Every day we help our major global clients deliver ambitious and highly technical projects, in over 130 countries worldwide.

Our team is dynamic, innovative and client-focused, supported by an inclusive and fun company culture. Our clients value our proactive approach, depth of expertise, integrity and the quality we deliver. As a result our people get to enjoy working on some of the most exciting projects in the world.

**Job Description**

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven
**Project Manager – Interior Design & Fit-Out**
to lead end-to-end execution of commercial, residential, retail, hospitality, or workplace interior projects. The incumbent will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering projects within scope, budget, quality standards, and timelines while managing cross-functional teams, vendors, contractors, and client stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Project Planning & Execution

* Manage the complete lifecycle of interior fit-out projects from project handover to final closure.
* Develop project schedules, execution plans, resource allocation, and procurement strategies.
* Ensure timely delivery of projects while maintaining quality, safety, and cost objectives.
* Monitor project progress and proactively resolve issues impacting timelines or budgets.
* Conduct regular site inspections and review project milestones.

Client & Stakeholder Management

* Act as the primary point of contact for clients throughout project execution.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure customer satisfaction.
* Lead project review meetings and provide regular status updates to stakeholders.
* Manage client expectations and address escalations effectively.

Team & Vendor Management

* Lead and coordinate project engineers, site supervisors, designers, and contractors.
* Manage subcontractors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure adherence to project requirements.
* Monitor workforce productivity and ensure optimal utilization of resources.
* Foster a collaborative and performance-driven project environment.

Budget & Cost Control

* Prepare and manage project budgets and cost plans.
* Track project expenditures and identify opportunities for cost optimization.
* Review quotations, variation orders, invoices, and contractor bills.
* Ensure project profitability and control budget deviations.

Quality & Compliance

* Ensure compliance with design specifications, industry standards, and safety regulations.
* Implement quality control procedures and conduct regular inspections.
* Drive adherence to company SOPs, EHS guidelines, and project governance processes.
* Manage snagging, punch-list activities, and project handover documentation.

Risk Management

* Identify project risks and develop mitigation strategies.
* Manage project changes and ensure minimal impact on delivery schedules.
* Maintain proper documentation of project plans, reports, contracts, and approvals.

**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Interior Design, Construction Management, or related field.
* PMP, PRINCE2, or Project Management certification is preferred.
* 10–12 years of experience in interior fit-out, construction, workplace, retail, hospitality, or commercial projects.
* Proven experience managing multiple large-scale interior projects simultaneously.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong project management and execution capabilities.
* Excellent knowledge of interior fit-out materials, construction methodologies, and site operations.
* Proficiency in project planning tools such as MS Project, Primavera, or equivalent.
* Strong commercial acumen and budget management skills.
* Excellent stakeholder and client management abilities.
* Strong leadership, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Knowledge of health, safety, and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Additional Information**

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

title: Enterprise Platform Advisor
description:
**Project Role :**
Enterprise Platform Advisor
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Provide consulting services and advice on complex enterprise transformations involving one or more technology platforms. Advise on platform selection, technology cost optimization and/or value levers. Develop and implement market-leading industry- and/or function-specific technology assets.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Change Management
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 2 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
Change Management – Analyst
  
  
Summary: As a Change Management Analyst, you will support clients through the organizational, cultural and workforce shifts that come with large platform-led transformation. You will work as part of a change workstream on a live client programme - running stakeholder and change impact analysis, building communications and learning assets, tracking readiness and adoption, and helping business teams get ready for new ways of working.
  
  
You will be expected to deliver your own tasks independently, with guidance from a consultant or Change Lead, and to grow steadily into a subject matter expert in one or more change capabilities. This role offers strong consulting foundations, industry exposure and hands-on experience with AI-enabled change accelerators.
  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:-
  
  
Change strategy, impact and readiness
  
  
Conduct stakeholder analysis and maintain stakeholder maps, engagement plans and RACI views for assigned business units or geographies.
  
  
Run change impact assessments - capture process, system, role and behaviour changes, and translate them into practical mitigation actions.
  
  
Support business readiness tracking through readiness criteria, checklists, surveys and pulse checks ahead of each deployment wave.
  
  
Contribute to change strategy documents, change plans, case-for-change narratives and leadership alignment material.
  
  
Communications and engagement
  
  
Draft and produce change communications - emails, newsletters, intranet and Viva Engage posts, FAQs, leadership messages, posters and videos - aligned to the approved communication plan and client brand.
  
  
Maintain the communications calendar, manage approvals and track distribution and reach.
  
  
Support change champion and super-user networks: onboarding material, toolkits, forums, recognition and feedback loops.
  
  
Help plan and run engagement moments such as town halls, roadshows, demo days, floor walks and adoption campaigns.
  
  
Learning and enablement
  
  
Support training needs analysis and role-to-course mapping for impacted user groups.
  
  
Develop end-user enablement assets - job aids, quick reference cards, e-learning storyboards, simulations, how-to videos and instructor decks.
  
  
Coordinate training logistics, LMS uploads, attendance tracking, train-the-trainer sessions and post-training feedback.
  
  
Support hyper care and floor-walking activity around go-live and capture recurring user issues for resolution.
  
  
Adoption, analytics and AI accelerators
  
  
Use generative AI, agentic AI and other change accelerators to improve the speed, quality and personalization of change deliverables.
  
  
Track readiness, adoption, sentiment and proficiency metrics using digital adoption platforms, usage telemetry and survey tools.
  
  
Build and refresh adoption dashboards and status reports highlight trends, risk areas and recommended interventions.
  
  
Support value measurement by linking adoption data to programme benefits and business outcomes.
  
  
Delivery, governance and teaming
  
  
Own assigned deliverables end to end - quality, version control, client review cycles and on-time completion.
  
  
Maintain change trackers, RAID logs, governance packs and weekly or monthly status reporting for the change workstream.
  
  
Collaborate with business, functional, technical, deployment and PMO teams to keep change activity aligned to programme milestones.
  
  
Contribute to reusable assets, accelerators, templates and internal knowledge sharing for the practice.
  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
  
Must have
  
  
Core Change Management
  
  
Change Impact & Business Readiness
  
  
Training & Learning Transformation
  
  
Change Communications & Engagement
  
  
Enterprise Platform Transformation exposure – SAP (including S/4HANA and SuccessFactors), Microsoft, Oracle, UKG or Workday
  
  
Strong written English, PowerPoint and Excel capability
  
  
Change PMO / Governance
  
  
Good to have
  
  
Agentic AI & AI Adoption (including Microsoft 365 Copilot enablement)
  
  
Change Analytics / Digital Adoption platforms (e.g. WalkMe, Viva Insights, Power BI)
  
  
PROSCI / APMG Change Management certification
  
  
Exposure to project management methodologies (Agile, waterfall, hybrid)
  
  
Creative design tools for communications, video and survey design
  
  
Additional Information:
  
  
Experience: 2-4 years of relevant change management experience
  
  
Locations: Bengaluru, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Noida
  
  
Education: 15 years of full-time education graduate degree or equivalent, MBA/PGDM preferred
  
  
Certification: PROSCI / APMG Change Management certification preferred
  
  
Mobility: May require mobility to client locations across India
  
  
Soft Skills required: Structured thinking, Communication, Storytelling, Collaboration, Adaptability, Ownership, Flexibility

Master's Degree

title: Data Platform Consultant (Architecture & Engineering)
description:
**Microsoft Fabric Platform Architect**

**India (Remote)**
**2 Month Contract**

iO Associates has partnered with a growing organisation embarking on a significant data platform transformation to hire an experienced
**Microsoft Fabric Platform Architect**
. This is a hands-on architecture engagement focused on designing and establishing a new enterprise data platform using Microsoft Fabric.

This role is ideal for a contractor who enjoys operating at both a strategic and technical level. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to understand business objectives, challenge assumptions where needed, and define a scalable architecture that supports current reporting requirements while enabling future analytics, AI, and Machine Learning initiatives.

The primary objective is to establish the platform foundations, technical standards, governance framework, and core architecture before handing over to a permanent platform owner who will drive the long-term evolution of the environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  
* Design and define the end-to-end Microsoft Fabric platform architecture
* Establish technical standards, governance principles, and platform best practices
* Translate business requirements into scalable and sustainable technical solutions
* Provide architectural leadership and challenge existing approaches where appropriate
* Recommend technology choices to support long-term platform scalability and business goals
* Configure and establish the core Microsoft Fabric environment
* Design and implement Lakehouse and Medallion Architecture frameworks (Bronze, Silver, Gold)
* Define data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data modelling standards
* Establish workspace structures, development standards, and deployment approaches
* Implement governance, security, and access control frameworks
* Evaluate and recommend the appropriate use of SQL, Python, and PySpark across the platform
* Design scalable data engineering patterns to support analytics, reporting, and AI use cases
* Create architecture documentation, platform standards, and technical design artefacts
* Document architectural decisions, future recommendations, and operational guidance
* Deliver a structured knowledge transfer and handover to the permanent platform owner

  

**Requirements:**

  
* 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Architecture, or Data Platform Engineering
* Proven experience designing and implementing Microsoft Fabric platforms
* Strong understanding of Medallion Architecture and modern data platform design principles
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Fabric Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, Pipelines, and OneLake
* Strong SQL expertise with the ability to determine when alternative approaches such as PySpark are appropriate
* Experience using Python and PySpark for scalable data engineering solutions
* Experience with dbt and YAML-based configuration frameworks
* Strong knowledge of platform governance, security, and access control principles
* Experience producing architecture documentation, technical standards, and platform governance frameworks
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Strong consulting and stakeholder management skills with the confidence to challenge requirements constructively

  

**Desirable Experience:**

  
* Experience designing data platforms that support AI and Machine Learning initiatives
* Knowledge of the wider Azure Data Platform ecosystem
* Previous experience in consulting, transformation, or greenfield platform programmes
* Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps, and Infrastructure-as-Code methodologies
* Experience supporting global data governance and regulatory compliance requirements

  

If you're interested, please send your CV to
**a.kumar@ioassociates.co.uk**
.

title: Supply Chain AI Solutions Architect
description:
Cognizant is looking to hire a Supply Chain AI Solutions Architect who will be part of the SCM AI practice within our Product Delivery Team (EPS). The role spans three areas: presales solutioning, running customer pilots in Supply Chain AI, and solutions architecture for new SC/AI offerings. You will work closely with Sales/BD, Functional SCM, and senior architecture reviewers to turn incoming requests into credible technical responses, then carry validated solutions through pilot delivery. A strong grasp of both AI-based solutioning and traditional SCM technical architecture is needed, along with depth in at least one functional area of Supply Chain.
  
  
**What You'll Do -**
Presales
  
  

* Own first-level technical solutioning for RFPs, RFIs, and SOWs - AI/agentic solutions and traditional custom builds (integrations, data architecture)
* Map requests to existing solution patterns; escalate novel or complex asks to senior architecture review
* Provide effort sizing and feasibility calls under bid deadlines
* Draft technical solution sections of proposals - architecture, differentiators, risks, dependencies
* Apply Cognizant pricing model with reuse in mind

Customer Pilots
  
  

* Run customer pilots for SC AI solutions - scoping, execution, and measurement against KPIs
* Act as technical point of contact through the pilot lifecycle, coordinating with client and internal teams
* Convert pilot outcomes into case studies and reusable proof points

Solutions Architecture
  
  

* Design solution architecture for new SC/AI offerings - data models, integration patterns, platform-to-play mapping
* Liaise with platform teams (Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Manhattan, SAP) on new capabilities
* Contribute to the SC AI play portfolio, keeping architecture reusable across clients

**Qualifications, Experience And Aptitude -**

* 8-12 years in SCM technology consulting, with presales/solution architecture exposure
* Hands-on experience with both AI/agentic solutions and traditional integration/data builds
* Strength in one SC functional area (Planning/Forecasting, WMS, Order Management, Control Tower) plus working knowledge across the broader SC landscape
* Working knowledge preferred across any of: Kinaxis, Blue Yonder, Manhattan, 09 (or similar)
* Life Sciences, Retail, or Manufacturing exposure preferred
* Familiarity with AI maturity frameworks a plus
* Strong communication skills - clear technical writing under deadline pressure, confident client engagement during pilots
* Self-driven, proactive and attention to detail necessary
* Based in India (Bangalore/Chennai preferred); limited travel for pilot engagements

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Capital Market/Treasury Implementation Consultant**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a Capital Markets/Treasury Implementation Consultant (Senior Consultant level) with experience in Capital Markets and Treasury platform implementation, post-trade operations, and technology transformation. The role involves supporting end-to-end delivery of platform implementation and modernization initiatives across trade confirmations, settlements, securities processing, treasury operations, and regulatory reporting. The consultant will work closely with business, operations, risk, and technology stakeholders to design, configure, test, deploy, and stabilize solutions across Capital Markets and Treasury ecosystems.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Participate in the implementation, enhancement, and modernization of Capital Markets and Treasury platforms.
* Support business and technology workstreams across platform configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and production stabilization activities.
* Collaborate with Front Office, Middle Office, Back Office, Operations, Risk, Compliance, and Technology teams to deliver transformation programs.
* Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional and technical solutions.
* Conduct workshops, stakeholder discussions, and gap assessments to identify platform configuration and customization requirements.
* Support trade lifecycle processes including trade capture, confirmations, settlements, reconciliations, accounting, and reporting.
* Assist with system integrations using industry-standard interfaces and messaging protocols.
* Support SIT, UAT, defect management, production validation, and post-implementation activities.
* Prepare project documentation, including business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, and test artifacts.
* Participate in Agile or Waterfall project delivery methodologies and contribute to project governance activities.
* Guide junior team members and support successful workstream execution.

**Required Skills & Experience**

* Capital Markets & Treasury Domain Knowledge
* Strong understanding of Capital Markets, Treasury, Investment Banking, and Post-Trade Operations.
* Knowledge of trade lifecycle processes including trade capture, confirmations, matching, settlements, accounting, reconciliations, and reporting.
* Experience in trade confirmations, settlement processing, securities operations, SSI management, exception handling, and counterparty management.
* Understanding of operational controls, regulatory reporting, reconciliation processes, and settlement fail management.
* Experience across one or more asset classes including:


+ Foreign Exchange (FX)
+ Fixed Income
+ Equities
+ Money Markets
+ Derivatives (Futures, Swaps, Options)

**Platform & Implementation Experience**

* 5-8 years of experience implementing, configuring, enhancing, supporting, or integrating Capital Markets and Treasury platforms such as:

+ Murex
+ Calypso/Adenza
+ Kondor+/Fusion Kondor
+ Finastra Fusion
+ SunGard Treasury
+ Broadridge Gloss
+ Fidessa
+ MarkitSERV
+ Summit
+ Or equivalent Treasury and Capital Markets platforms

* Experience supporting large-scale transformation, implementation, or modernization programs.
* Ability to conduct gap analysis between business requirements and standard platform capabilities.

**Technical Skills**

* Working knowledge of Java, Python, PL/SQL, .NET, or similar technologies.
* Experience with Oracle, Sybase, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or equivalent databases.
* Unix/Linux shell scripting experience.
* Understanding of enterprise integration frameworks, APIs, XML, MQ, and messaging technologies.
* Knowledge of financial market connectivity standards including SWIFT MT/MX, FIX, ISO 20022, and settlement interfaces.
* Exposure to DevOps, release management, deployment processes, and environment management.
* Experience supporting system integrations, data reconciliations, and operational issue resolution.

**Functional & Consulting Skills**

* Requirements gathering, business analysis, documentation, and stakeholder management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to propose scalable, configuration-driven solutions.
* Experience facilitating workshops and engaging with business and technology stakeholders.
* Experience supporting SIT, UAT, defect triage, and production validation.
* Ability to review test cases and collaborate with QA and testing teams.
* Familiarity with Agile (Scrum/Kanban) and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Strong communication and client-facing consulting skills.
* Ability to independently manage workstreams and mentor junior consultants.

**Desirable Knowledge**

* Experience with market infrastructure and utility platforms such as SWIFT, DTCC, Omgeo CTM, Traiana, MarkitSERV, or equivalent solutions.
* Knowledge of valuation, pricing, risk management, VaR, P&L, and treasury operations workflows.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, Computer Science, Finance, or a related discipline (BE/BTech/MCA preferred).
* MBA (Finance) or relevant financial markets certification is advantageous.
* 5-8 years of experience in Capital Markets, Treasury Technology, Post-Trade Operations, or Financial Services technology implementation.
* Experience working with banks, broker-dealers, custodians, market infrastructure providers, treasury functions, or financial institutions.
* Proven track record of contributing to Capital Markets or Treasury transformation and implementation programs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Master's Degree

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Workflow Automation Expertise: Familiarity with workflow automation and event-driven patterns, including building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and implementing orchestration layers, is beneficial for this role.
* LLMOps Practices Knowledge: Exposure to LLMOps practices, including implementing observability, performance tuning, and cost optimization measures, is advantageous for ensuring reliable and scalable AI solutions.
* Secure Deployment Experience: Experience with deploying AI services, APIs, and orchestration layers in compliance with organizational and regulatory standards is desirable, ensuring secure and efficient deployment.

title: Tech S and T - Enterprise Application Architect-BAT -Senior Manager-GDS04
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – Application Architect - Senior Manager**
**The opportunity**
The Application Architect (Senior Manager) is responsible for building the detailed solution(s) for Applications in Cloud Transformation context. This role works under the guidance of the Account/Engagement Partner and the Enterprise Architect. This role works 50% on new opportunities shaping in existing or new client context and has 50% involvement in Delivery.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work with the end client, engagement partners, and enterprise architects to understand client business requirements, priorities, and the business case of the Technology Transformation.
* Work with consulting teams to incorporate domain/sector specific solutions. Have an AI first approach in solutioning & Architecting.
* Build Application Architecture by choosing the right technologies and platforms, including Integration, API Management layers & AI infusion.
* Work with the Competencies and Practices to arrive at suitable project approach, provide estimates and inputs to staffing plan.
* Work with the Delivery Governance team to analyse project delivery risks and mitigations.
* Delivery involvement as the “Solution Architect” to bring to life the conceived solution. Build the architecture, and project implementation/development/delivery framework

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 10-15 years of experience in Technology Consulting and System Integration projects
* 5+ years’ experience in Cloud Transformation projects – involving Cloud Application Architecture, Cloud Native Application principles
* Experience in working & managing global stakeholders.
* Should have driven significant business outcomes as a part of their role.
* Hands-on experience in driving Application migrations to cloud including a combination of Lift & Shit, Re-platform, Re-factor or Re-architecture
* Hands-on experience in building Cloud Native Applications, APIs; knowledge of Application and Integration design patterns.
* Experience in Application Architecture & Design for Microservices in Cloud platforms
* Expertise in at least one Cloud Hyperscaler (AWS or Azure preferred);
* Deep work experience in atleast one API platform (Apigee, Mulesoft, Boomi etc)
* TOGAF certification will be a plus
* Experience in any of these sectors will be a plus - TMT (Telco, Media, Technology), Public Sector, Energy & Utilities and Travel & Leisure

**What We Look For**

* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: AVP, Project Management (L11)
description:
**Role Title: AVP, Project Management (L11)**
**Company Overview:**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The Project Manager supports S2P delivery by managing the backlog in a blended Kanban/Scrum model—driving refinement, ensuring stories meet requirement standards, and routing enablers to the Program Manager. The role supports PI prioritization, manages QC to ensure documentation compliance, and maintains delivery artifacts and reporting. This position also coordinates mini-project scheduling and may lead small projects, proactively managing timelines, “RAID” items, dependencies, and continuous process improvements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish and manage the backlog process for all Source to Pay functions using a Kanban or Scrum approach, ensuring transparency, prioritization, and readiness for delivery.
* Drive backlog refinement activities to ensure:
* Stories contain clearly defined requirements (e.g., objective, scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, estimates, priority), meeting definition of ready.
* Enablers are identified with clearly documented objectives, outputs, and prioritized.
* Manage a QC process to ensure Program Managers adhere to documentation guidelines
* Drive the Program Increment (PI) prioritization process, partnering with stakeholders to intake work, align priorities, and sequence items based on value and need.
* Manage small project scheduling and coordination, including creating the structure, processes, and templates to develop timeline tracking, task sequencing, meeting coordination, and follow-up on action items.
* Manage projects as needed, including planning, prioritization, scope tracking, status reporting, and risk/issue/dependency (RAID) management.
* Maintain delivery artifacts and reporting (e.g., project minutes and action items, approval, testing and other documentation, decision logs, and schedules).
* Identify and escalate blockers, risks, and cross-team dependencies; propose resolution options and coordinate next steps.
* Promote continuous improvement in intake, prioritization, refinement, and flow efficiency across the S2P delivery process.

**Required Skills & Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience
* 3+ years in Project Management/Agile delivery role utilizing Scrum and/or Kanban
* Scrum Master Certification or Service Delivery Manager
* Experience writing/supporting user stories (scope, acceptance criteria) and tracking dependencies/estimates.
* Experience managing a PI/quarterly prioritization (or similar intake and sequencing) process.
* Enforce documentation standards by managing a quality control process.
* Proficient with Jira/Confluence and MS Office (Excel/PowerPoint/Visio)
* Experience with identifying and developing process metrics

**Desired Characteristics**

* Familiarity with Source to Pay teams and Coupa preferred.
* Experience summarizing complex projects, risks, or ideas to Senior Leadership in a concise manner.
* Detail-oriented and documentation-focused; produces audit-ready artifacts.
* Comfortable with ambiguity with ability to break work down for sequencing.
* Strong organization, communication and facilitation skills
* Proactive communicator who escalates risks/dependencies early and drives follow-through.
* Continuous improvement and curious mindset with interest in flow/throughput metrics.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience or in lieu of a degree 6+ years of Sourcing, Procurement, Supplier Management experience

**Work Timings: 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM EST**
**For Internal Applicants**

* Understand the criteria or mandatory skills required for the role, before applying
* Inform your manager or HRM before applying for the role on Workday
* Ensure that your professional profile is updated (fields such as education, prior experience, skills) and it is mandatory to upload your updated resume (Word or PDF format)
* Must not be any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP)
* L9+ Employees who have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role and level are only eligible.
* L09+ Employees can apply.

**Grade/Level: 11**
**Job Family Group**
Other Business Administration

title: Assistant Manager- Civil
description:
**Who is Turner & Townsend?**

All over the world people are using buildings, infrastructure, and assets we helped to deliver. It could be the hospital they work in, the railway they travel on every day, the fuel that powers their car or the data centre they depend on at work. For more than 75 years we’ve been helping to deliver transformational programmes across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, making a difference to people’s lives and ensuring a return on investment for our clients and their investors.

**Our purpose:**

**Transforming performance for a green, inclusive, and productive world.**

The world is changing and we have a responsibility to support that change, helping drive it and be part of it. Through the commitment, capability and care our team brings, we build trust between clients, suppliers, governments and society. Delivering better outcomes that have a positive impact on the world around us. We work smarter to face the challenges of the future; bringing the clarity that helps teams realise their full potential across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors. It’s how we’ve made the difference for more than 75 years.

**Our values:**

**Love a challenge:**
We love a challenge and we work hard to make change happen and see things through. We don’t stand still, challenging ourselves and others to do better every day. And we are trusted to do the right thing, raising standards all the time.

**Stronger together:**
We’re stronger together by connecting people in diverse teams, so that we can all collaborate to deliver our best work. We focus on what matters and use our influence to build a better world for everyone.

**Bring out the best in everyone:**
We bring out the best in everyone. We help each other to make the most of our potential, always learning from our experience. We treat each other with care and respect and make time to give everyone a voice

**Job Description**

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced
**Assistant Manager - Civil**
to support the planning, execution, and delivery of construction projects. The role involves overseeing site operations, coordinating with stakeholders, monitoring project progress, ensuring quality and safety compliance, and driving timely project completion within budget.

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution & Site Management

* Supervise and manage day-to-day civil construction activities at project sites.
* Ensure execution of work as per approved drawings, specifications, project schedules, and quality standards.
* Coordinate with contractors, consultants, vendors, and internal teams for smooth project execution.
* Monitor project milestones and proactively resolve site-related challenges.
* Ensure availability of resources including manpower, materials, and equipment.

Planning & Coordination

* Assist in project planning, scheduling, and resource allocation activities.
* Review construction drawings, BOQs, method statements, and technical specifications.
* Coordinate with MEP, architectural, planning, and procurement teams to ensure seamless project delivery.
* Participate in project review meetings and provide progress updates.

Quality Management

* Monitor construction quality and ensure compliance with company standards and project specifications.
* Conduct regular site inspections and quality audits.
* Ensure corrective actions are implemented for non-conformance issues.
* Coordinate with QA/QC teams to maintain documentation and quality records.

Safety & Compliance

* Ensure strict adherence to HSE policies and statutory regulations.
* Promote a safe working environment through regular safety inspections and toolbox talks.
* Monitor contractor compliance with safety standards and site procedures.
* Support implementation of safety initiatives across project sites.

Cost & Contract Management

* Monitor material consumption and project expenditures.
* Assist in budget tracking and cost control measures.
* Verify contractor bills, work measurements, and progress claims.
* Support evaluation of variations, change orders, and project claims.

Reporting & Documentation

* Maintain project documentation including daily reports, site records, inspection reports, and progress updates.
* Prepare weekly and monthly project status reports.
* Ensure timely submission of project documentation, approvals, and handover records.
* Track project KPIs and escalate critical issues when required.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering.
* Additional certifications in Project Management, Construction Management, or Quality Management will be an advantage.

**Qualifications**

Experience & Skills

* 8–10 years of experience in civil construction projects.
* Experience in commercial, residential, industrial, infrastructure, or mixed-use developments.
* Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, civil engineering practices, and project management principles.
* Familiarity with IS codes, construction standards, and safety regulations.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Project/Primavera, and Microsoft Office Suite.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

**Additional Information**

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/

Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner & Townsend and our exciting future projects:

Twitter

Instagram

LinkedIn

title: SAP CCM - Condition Contract Management
description:
Job Description: SAP CCM
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**SAP CCM**
with
**8 to 10 years**
of hands-on expertise across Application Maintenance (AM) support and Application Development (AD)/enhancements. The ideal candidate will possess deep specialization in
**SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebate processing, accruals, and settlement logic—backed by robust knowledge of
**SAP SD and Pricing**
.
  
  
In this role, you will lead complex enhancements, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support in an S/4HANA enterprise environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enhancements & Application Development (AD)**

* Process Enhancement & Delivery: Lead the design and delivery of CCM enhancements, including new condition contract types, specialized settlement logic, and custom rebate models tailored to evolving business requirements.
* Functional Specifications: Gather business requirements and translate them into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for custom RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement parameters, and cross-module integration points.
* Development & Testing: Partner closely with technical (ABAP) teams through development, unit testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure defect-free production releases.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive process optimization and automation initiatives within CCM and pricing operational workflows.

**Application Maintenance & Production Support (AM)**

* L2/L3 Incident Management: Deliver high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM operations, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs and minimal business disruption.
* Troubleshooting & Resolution: Analyze and resolve complex issues related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing discrepancies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring defects and implement permanent preventive fixes.
* ITSM Governance: Efficiently manage incidents, problem records, and service requests within ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and support period-end settlement runs and corresponding financial postings.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance**

* Integration Alignment: Collaborate with SD and FI teams to resolve complex, cross-module integration issues and ensure seamless Order-to-Cash (O2C) processing.
* Change Management: Adhere strictly to change management, transport release, and governance protocols for all system enhancements.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain detailed functional documentation, conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions, and promote standard SAP best practices.

**Required Candidate Profile**

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP hands-on experience covering both Application Support (AMS) and Enhancements/Implementations in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Core Functional Expertise: Deep domain expertise in SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)—rebates, accruals, settlements, and contract maintenance.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid expertise in SAP SD (Order-to-Cash) and advanced SAP Pricing Procedure configurations.
* Technical Interface Skills: Proven track record of designing functional specs for custom RICEF objects and working with ABAP teams.
* Support Proficiency: Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and standard ITIL support processes.

* Experienced in diagnosing and resolving complex authentication, authorization, and federation issues.
* Experience in supporting platform administration activities, including upgrades, deployments, patching, and environment maintenance.
* Strong knowledge of certificate administration in ISAM, including troubleshooting SSL/TLS, signer, personal, and key database certificate-related issues.
* Understanding of IAM governance, configuration management, operational controls, and industry best practices.
* Willingness to work in a client-focused environment with flexibility to support evolving business and operational requirements.
* Should have knowledge of different integration and architecture in customer’s IAM environment such as Load Balancer, network components
* Understanding of latest technology such as Zero trust framework, Fine-grained authorization, Password less authentication, CIAM
* Ability to develop documentation such as business requirement document, high and low level design document, training and user procedures document.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Strong command on verbal and written English language.

* Strong interpersonal and presentation skills.
* 3-4 Years’ Work Experience

**Certification:**

* Desirable to have certifications in security domain, such as CISSP and CISA or any IAM product specific certifications
* Desirable to have certifications in IBM Security Access Manager or IBM Security Verify Access

title: Head of Operations
description:
**Role purpose**

The Head of Operations runs the organisation day to day so the CEO can focus on strategy, partnerships and growth.

This person owns organisational effectiveness. They make sure teams deliver programmes and tasks on time, decisions get made and followed through, and performance is tracked against clear targets. They set up the structures, systems and dashboards that let a multi-state, multi-programme organisation run smoothly.

We are looking for a strong executor: someone who manages projects closely, keeps data current, coordinates teams and supports senior leadership with clear information and follow-up.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Programme delivery across the organisation**

* Track delivery of every programme against its annual and half-yearly (H1/H2) plan, budget and donor commitments.
* Run weekly and monthly delivery reviews with each vertical and program lead; flag delays early and agree corrective actions.
* Make sure donor reports, utilisation certificates and compliance deadlines are met on time, working with programme and finance teams.
* Coordinate shared resources (field staff, events) across verticals and states.

**2. Team performance**

* Set up and run the performance system: KRAs, weekly and monthly reviews and bi annual appraisals for all teams.
* Help vertical leads write clear KRAs and track them through the year.
* Support onboarding of senior hires with expectation notes, JDs and KRA trackers.
* Identify capacity gaps and work with HR on hiring, training and team structure.

**3. Systems, structures and decision-making**

* Define who decides what: approval limits, escalation paths and meeting rhythms (weekly leadership meeting, monthly reviews, quarterly planning).
* Write and maintain SOPs for core processes: procurement, travel, field operations, partner onboarding and document management.
* Make sure decisions from leadership meetings are recorded, assigned and closed.
* Work with Finance, HR and Admin to keep policies current and followed.

**4. Dashboards and reporting**

* Build and maintain an organisation-wide dashboard covering programme progress (activities and outputs), budgets, team KRAs, support team progress and key risks.
* Prepare monthly updates for the ON Sr Leadership and quarterly updates for the Board.

**5. Support to senior leadership**

* Act as the CEO's operational counterpart: prepare briefs, follow up on actions and keep priorities moving.
* Coordinate cross-team projects that need more than one vertical, such as new programme launches and multi-partner proposals.
* Represent the CEO in internal reviews and selected external meetings

**6. External relationships**

* Manage day-to-day operational relationships with donors, CSR partners, government departments and implementation partners.
* Make sure partner agreements, MOUs and reporting timelines are tracked and met.

**Who we are looking for**

**Experience**

* At least 15 years of work experience, with a significant part in operations leadership.
* Has led multiple teams at the same time, ideally across locations or states.
* Has run operations in a MNC/ development-sector organisation, social enterprise, CSR programme or a similar multi-programme or project setup.
* Has worked with donor-funded or CSR-funded programmes and their reporting and compliance requirements.

**Skills**

* Project management: plans work, tracks timelines, and closes loops without being chased.
* Dashboards and data: comfortable building and maintaining trackers in Excel or Google Sheets; familiarity with tools like Power BI, Notion or Asana is a plus.
* Performance systems: has designed or run KRA, OKR or appraisal processes.
* Process design: writes clear, simple SOPs that field teams actually use.
* Communication: writes crisp updates for leadership and Boards; comfortable in English and Hindi; Bengali is a plus.

**Attributes**

* A strong executor who takes ownership and follows through.
* Calm under pressure and able to juggle many priorities.
* Builds trust with team leads while holding them to commitments.
* Comfortable with travel to field locations.
* Willing to work in a start-up like, unstructured environment

**Education**

* Graduate degree required; a postgraduate degree in management, rural management or development is preferred.

**Compensation**

The CTC for this role is ₹18–24 lakh per annum, based on experience.

**Why join us?**

* Run operations for green livelihoods programmes across India.
* Work directly with the CEO and leadership team, and shape how the organisation runs and grows.
* Build the systems, dashboards and performance processes that every team will use.
* Work with national and international donors, CSR partners and government on programmes with real field impact.
* Join a Great Place to Work® certified organisation.

**About SwitchON Foundation**

Established in 2008, SwitchON Foundation is a pioneering non-profit organization committed to driving sustainable development through innovative solutions in climate-resilient agriculture, clean energy, green livelihoods, and industry decarbonization. With a passionate team of over 175+ professionals, we operate across 10 states in India, empowering communities with climate-smart technologies and practices.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work, SwitchON Foundation takes pride in its inclusive and diverse workplace, with strong representation of women in leadership roles. Our impact is amplified through a combination of innovative programs, social enterprises, and strategic policy advocacy aimed at creating lasting change.

To learn more about our work, please visit:
www.switchon.org.in

title: SAP C-ALM
description:
**Position Executive Summary**
We are seeking a seasoned
**Lead SAP Cloud ALM & Enterprise Toolchain Architect**
to define, govern, and operationalize the complete Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) strategy for our global Greenfield SAP S/4HANA transformation program.
  
  
Acting as the single point of accountability for SAP Cloud ALM adoption across all global regions and workstreams, the ideal candidate will establish cross-functional governance, build end-to-end lifecycle traceability, integrate enterprise toolchains, and drive quality engineering across all phases of the SAP Activate framework.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities & Core Governance**
  
  

* Cloud ALM Strategy & Governance
* Strategy Definition: Formulate and execute a comprehensive Cloud ALM strategy aligned with SAP Activate methodology across all global rollout templates.
* Governance Framework: Establish and enforce ALM governance standards across requirements gathering, business process hierarchy modeling, testing execution, defect management, deployment controls, and operations.
* Single Accountability: Serve as the central point of contact and accountability for Cloud ALM adoption across global regions, system integrators, and project workstreams.
* Enterprise Toolchain Integration & Traceability
* Toolchain Management: Architect and manage data flows across the integrated ALM toolchain, connecting SAP Cloud ALM with enterprise architecture, modeling, testing, and operational tools.
* End-to-End Lineage: Maintain complete vertical and horizontal traceability across the lifecycle: Business Scope → Process Design → Requirements/User Stories → Development Units → Test Cases → Defects → Transports/Deployments.
* Integration Engineering: Design and implement robust integration and real-time data synchronization between SAP Cloud ALM and enterprise solutions, including:

+ Process Modeling: Signavio
+ Architecture & Capability Mapping: LeanIX
+ Work Management & ITSM: Jira / ServiceNow
+ Test Management: Tricentis, HP ALM, or equivalent
+ Documentation Systems: Confluence, SharePoint

* Solution Enablement & Fit-to-Standard Execution

title: Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses
description:
**Head of Strategic Research & Business Analyses**

**Brainware University seeks an analytical and resourceful professional to lead a team of bright young AI researchers to work on problems relating to admissions, placements, HR, cost control, programme performance and institutional growth.**

**The role**

You will translate management concerns into clearly formulated problems, identify the questions that matter, investigate available evidence and recommend practical solutions.

The work will rely primarily on secondary research, supplemented by available university data discussions with relevant colleagues and market research.

Information will sometimes be incomplete. You must be able to make reasonable assumptions, explain their basis and assess how they affect your conclusions.

**Key responsibilities**

* Structure problems into specific questions, research tasks and measurable outcomes.
* Research comparable institutions, industry practices, market trends and relevant benchmarks.
* Develop realistic estimates and financial or operational models using clearly stated assumptions.
* Assess alternative solutions in terms of cost, feasibility, likely benefit and implementation requirements.
* Present concise recommendations explaining what should be done, why, by whom and how results should be measured.
* Refine recommendations as new evidence becomes available.

**What we are looking for**

* Strong analytical ability, intellectual curiosity and practical judgement.
* Ability to distinguish reliable evidence from unsupported claims.
* Confidence working with numbers, spreadsheets and incomplete information.
* Clear, concise writing and the ability to explain complex findings simply.
* Ability to work independently and question assumptions constructively.
* Responsible use of AI research tools, including verification of sources and calculations.

**Candidates may come from consulting, business analysis, economics, finance, operations, market research or related backgrounds. Experience in higher education would be preferred. Demonstrated problem-solving ability will carry more weight than a particular degree or designation.**

The expected output is a workable recommendation supported by evidence, transparent assumptions and an implementation plan.

**Selection process**

Shortlisted candidates will complete a brief practical case exercise and discuss their reasoning, assumptions and recommendations.

**Locations : Both Salt Lake and Barasat**

Team Size : 10 -15

Remuneration: Commensurate with capability and experience.

**To apply:**
Send your CV and a brief example of a problem you have analysed, explaining your approach, recommendation and outcome, to tulika.hr@brainwareuniversity.ac.in.

Subject line: Application — Strategic Research & Business Analyst

title: Head of Supply Chain Management
description:
**Position Title:**
Supply Chain Manager

**Company Name:**
Client of Birchtree Consulting (Retail)

**Location:**
Kolkata, India

**Experience Required:**
7–10 years

**CTC:**
35 to 45 LPA

Role Purpose

The Supply Chain Manager will own the end-to-end supply chain and production planning for the Fragrance business, from production planning and vendor coordination through to finished-product availability. The role will build and manage the vendor ecosystem, including international suppliers, align production with business projections and sales requirements, and ensure that products are available at the right time and in the right quantities. The role is highly execution-oriented and requires strong ownership of timelines, vendors, inventory, production schedules and cross-functional coordination.

Key Responsibilities

Demand & Production Planning

* Translate business projections, collection plans and sales forecasts into production requirements.
* Develop production plans based on expected demand, launch calendars, channel requirements and supplier lead times.
* Work closely with sales and merchandising teams to understand current and anticipated demand.
* Anticipate production requirements well in advance based on long lead-time components and international sourcing dependencies.
* Maintain visibility on production pipeline, committed quantities, expected receipts and potential supply gaps.
* Identify risks to product availability and proactively develop mitigation plans.

End-to-End Vendor Management

* Own relationships with domestic and international vendors involved in the fragrance supply chain.
* Identify, evaluate and onboard vendors in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders.
* Manage vendor negotiations around timelines, quantities, quality, costs and commercial terms.
* Establish vendor performance standards and review vendor performance regularly.
* Build strong relationships with international suppliers and manage communication across time zones and geographies.
* Ensure vendor adherence to agreed production and delivery timelines.

Production & Component Coordination

* Coordinate production of fragrance bottles, packaging components and other relevant product components.
* Track component-level production and identify dependencies that may affect finished-product timelines.
* Maintain detailed production trackers covering purchase orders, quantities, production status, quality approvals, dispatches and expected delivery dates.
* Coordinate with manufacturing/production partners to ensure timely completion of orders.
* Work with R&D and product teams during product development and transition from sampling to commercial production.

Inventory & Availability

* Establish appropriate inventory norms based on demand, lead times and business requirements.
* Monitor inventory levels and identify potential overstock, understock and stock-out situations.
* Develop replenishment plans based on sales velocity and production lead times.
* Ensure alignment between inventory availability and planned launches across channels.

Cross-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with R&D, CPO, merchandising, retail, finance, HR and other relevant teams.
* Coordinate production plans with collection launch calendars.
* Align with sales teams on market requirements, upcoming demand and changes in projections.
* Work with Finance on purchase commitments, costing, working capital and vendor payments where required.
* Ensure supply-chain readiness for new launches and collection drops.

Cost & Process Optimisation

* Track product and component costs and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
* Support costing exercises and vendor negotiations.
* Identify opportunities to reduce lead times, improve MOQ economics and optimise inventory.
* Build scalable supply-chain processes, trackers and SOPs for the new fragrance business.

International Supply Chain

* Manage international vendor relationships and associated production timelines.
* Coordinate international shipments and ensure visibility on expected arrival dates.
* Work with relevant internal teams on documentation, logistics and import-related dependencies.
* Build contingency plans for critical international suppliers and long-lead components.

Key Deliverables / Success Metrics

* Production readiness for all planned launches
* On-time-in-full delivery from vendors
* Production lead-time adherence
* Inventory availability and stock-out levels
* Vendor performance
* Inventory turns / working capital efficiency
* Production cost optimisation
* Accuracy of demand-to-production planning
* Successful execution of new product launches

Ideal Candidate

* 5–8 years of experience in supply chain, sourcing, production planning or vendor management.
* Experience in fragrance, beauty, cosmetics, luxury, premium consumer goods or a highly design-led product environment preferred.
* Strong experience managing vendors, preferably including international suppliers.
* Experience working with long-lead-time components and production cycles.
* Strong understanding of demand planning, inventory management and production scheduling.
* Excellent stakeholder and vendor management skills.
* Strong analytical and Excel capabilities.
* Comfortable working in a start-up/0-to-1 environment where processes need to be built from scratch.
* Willingness to travel internationally/domestically for vendor management where required.

Preferred Background

Candidates from fragrance, cosmetics, beauty, luxury packaging, premium consumer goods, fashion accessories, jewellery or other businesses involving complex vendor and component ecosystems may be considered.

title: Rooftop PV Site Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Vyomaa Energy is a reputed renewable energy services company based in India, delivering clean, affordable power to commercial, institutional, and industrial clients. The company executes Build, Own, Operate, and Transfer (BOOT) projects for commercial buildings, educational institutions, hospitals, warehouses, and industries. Vyomaa Energy also designs and installs small rooftop PV systems for residential homes and provides electrical storage solutions for decentralized electricity generation. The organization is committed to expanding access to sustainable energy while maintaining competitive pricing and reliable service. More information and updates are shared through its official Twitter channel.
  
**Role Description**
The Rooftop PV Site Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area. The role involves conducting site surveys, assessing rooftop suitability, and coordinating the structural and civil aspects of PV system installation. The Site Engineer will oversee installation activities, monitor quality and safety compliance, verify alignment with engineering designs, and support commissioning of rooftop solar systems. Responsibilities also include collaborating with project managers, contractors, and clients to ensure timely execution, resolving site-level issues, and preparing daily/weekly site reports. The role requires regular interaction with stakeholders, adherence to local regulations and standards, and contribution to continuous improvement of installation practices.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Ability to work effectively in on-site project environments, including active construction and installation sites.
* Strong communication skills for coordinating with clients, contractors, internal teams, and other stakeholders.
* Experience in quality control for solar or electrical installations, with a focus on safety, compliance, and performance standards.
* Knowledge of structural engineering principles relevant to rooftop solar mounting systems and load calculations.
* Background as a civil engineer or similar technical discipline with exposure to building structures and site work.
* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in civil engineering, electrical engineering, renewable energy, or a related field.
* Familiarity with rooftop PV system design, basic electrical concepts, and relevant codes and standards.
* Proficiency in site reporting, basic project documentation, and use of common engineering tools and software.
* Ability to travel within the Kolkata metropolitan area and work safely at heights and in outdoor conditions.
* Prior experience in solar rooftop projects or renewable energy installations is an advantage.
