title: Deployment Strategist
description:
**Job Description**
About the Team
  
  
The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes, not just a platform.
  
  
You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."
  
  
Role Description
  
  
As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.
  
  
You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.
  
  
This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.
  
  
The impact you will have
  
  

* C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.
* End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.
* Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.
* Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.
* Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for
  
  

* Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.
* Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.
* Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.
* Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.
* Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

**About Databricks**
Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.
  
  
**Benefits**
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.
  
  
Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion
  
  
At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.
  
  
Compliance
  
  
If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
**Position Title:**
Supply Chain Manager

**Location:**
West Bengal, India

**Experience Required:**
7–10 years

**CTC:**
35 - 45 LPA

**Role Purpose**

The Supply Chain Manager will own the end-to-end supply chain and production planning for the Beauty, Cosmetic, Perfumes, Alcohol business, from production planning and vendor coordination through to finished-product availability. The role will build and manage the vendor ecosystem, including international suppliers, align production with business projections and sales requirements, and ensure that products are available at the right time and in the right quantities. The role is highly execution-oriented and requires strong ownership of timelines, vendors, inventory, production schedules and cross-functional coordination.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Demand & Production Planning**

* Translate business projections, collection plans and sales forecasts into production requirements.
* Develop production plans based on expected demand, launch calendars, channel requirements and supplier lead times.
* Work closely with sales and merchandising teams to understand current and anticipated demand.
* Anticipate production requirements well in advance based on long lead-time components and international sourcing dependencies.
* Maintain visibility on production pipeline, committed quantities, expected receipts and potential supply gaps.
* Identify risks to product availability and proactively develop mitigation plans.

**End-to-End Vendor Management**

* Own relationships with domestic and international vendors involved in the supply chain.
* Identify, evaluate and onboard vendors in collaboration with relevant internal stakeholders.
* Manage vendor negotiations around timelines, quantities, quality, costs and commercial terms.
* Establish vendor performance standards and review vendor performance regularly.
* Build strong relationships with international suppliers and manage communication across time zones and geographies.
* Ensure vendor adherence to agreed production and delivery timelines.

**Production & Component Coordination**

* Coordinate production of fragrance bottles, packaging components and other relevant product components.
* Track component-level production and identify dependencies that may affect finished-product timelines.
* Maintain detailed production trackers covering purchase orders, quantities, production status, quality approvals, dispatches and expected delivery dates.
* Coordinate with manufacturing/production partners to ensure timely completion of orders.
* Work with R&D and product teams during product development and transition from sampling to commercial production.

**Inventory & Availability**

* Establish appropriate inventory norms based on demand, lead times and business requirements.
* Monitor inventory levels and identify potential overstock, understock and stock-out situations.
* Develop replenishment plans based on sales velocity and production lead times.
* Ensure alignment between inventory availability and planned launches across channels.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Work closely with R&D, CPO, merchandising, retail, finance, HR and other relevant teams.
* Coordinate production plans with collection launch calendars.
* Align with sales teams on market requirements, upcoming demand and changes in projections.
* Work with Finance on purchase commitments, costing, working capital and vendor payments where required.
* Ensure supply-chain readiness for new launches and collection drops.

**Cost & Process Optimisation**

* Track product and component costs and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.
* Support costing exercises and vendor negotiations.
* Identify opportunities to reduce lead times, improve MOQ economics and optimise inventory.
* Build scalable supply-chain processes, trackers and SOPs for the new fragrance business.

**International Supply Chain**

* Manage international vendor relationships and associated production timelines.
* Coordinate international shipments and ensure visibility on expected arrival dates.
* Work with relevant internal teams on documentation, logistics and import-related dependencies.
* Build contingency plans for critical international suppliers and long-lead components.

**Key Deliverables / Success Metrics**

* Production readiness for all planned launches
* On-time-in-full delivery from vendors
* Production lead-time adherence
* Inventory availability and stock-out levels
* Vendor performance
* Inventory turns / working capital efficiency
* Production cost optimisation
* Accuracy of demand-to-production planning
* Successful execution of new product launches

**Ideal Candidate**

* 5–8 years of experience in supply chain, sourcing, production planning or vendor management.
* Experience in fragrance, beauty, cosmetics, Alcohol, premium consumer goods or a highly design-led product environment preferred.
* Strong experience managing vendors, preferably including international suppliers.
* Experience working with long-lead-time components and production cycles.

title: Regional Aftermarket Manager(Kolkata)
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**
The Regional AM Manager leads customer support for injection moulding machines in the domestic market. The role is responsible for maintaining machine performance and uptime, delivering end-to-end customer support, strengthening customer relationships, and generating aftermarket business to achieve assigned service and sales revenue targets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer Support & Service Delivery**

* Lead the Customer Support Team for injection moulding machines in the domestic market.
* Provide end-to-end customer support covering machine installation, breakdown calls, technical troubleshooting, spare-parts support, operator training and processing-related issues.
* Ensure timely customer communication for machine installation activities and site-readiness requirements.
* Support customers with mould trials, both in-house and at customer sites, to enable machine shipment and successful commissioning.
* Visit customers regularly to maintain strong liaison, address service needs and support repeat business.

**Revenue, Collections & Aftermarket Growth**

**Reporting & Governance**

title: Manager, Internal Controls
description:
**Job Description**
The
**Manager, Internal Controls**
will be based in
**India**
. In this position, you will report to the Head of Internal Controls. Nextpower is seeking a Manager, Internal Control to lead the company’s SOX and internal controls work across assigned business processes. This role manages and develops a team of internal controls professionals while partnering with Finance, Accounting, IT, Operations, Legal, and external auditors. The manager sets team priorities, oversees routine operating plans and costs, and guides risk assessments, control design and testing, remediation, and readiness efforts. The role requires sound judgment, strong knowledge of business processes and financial reporting, and the ability to turn control requirements into practical solutions.
  
  
Watch “Culture is our Passion” to learn more about us
  
  
**We Are Looking For Someone Who Demonstrates**

* Passionate drive to innovate and create
* Integrity to the core
* Enthusiastic customer focus
* Consistent interactive teamwork
* Desire for continuous improvement and top performance.

**Here Is a Glimpse Of What You Will Do**
**People leadership and team operations**

* Manage, coach, and develop a team of internal controls professionals; set clear goals, assign work, review quality and timeliness, provide ongoing feedback, and support performance and career development.
* Plan and allocate team capacity against monthly and routine operating plans; monitor milestones, workload, and costs, and raise resource or schedule risks with leadership.
* Apply company policies consistently, address routine team matters, and recommend improvements to procedures and practices within the function.

**SOX program and control environment**

* Lead and contribute to SOX risk assessments, annual planning and scoping, readiness activities, and the ongoing maturity of the SOX program.
* Oversee assigned process areas and ensure the team understands related business activities, risks, controls, company policies, and applicable accounting and reporting requirements.
* Guide process walkthroughs, tests of design, and tests of operating effectiveness; review workpapers and documentation for accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
* Partner with process owners to evaluate existing processes, identify control gaps and improvement opportunities, and design practical controls that address risk and exposure.
* Assess new projects, systems, and process changes for SOX impact; coordinate with cross-functional partners to define and complete readiness actions.
* Maintain accurate SOX documentation, including process narratives, flowcharts, risk-control matrices, and evidence of control performance.

**Issues, remediation, and partnership**

* Evaluate audit findings and control deficiencies; analyze relevant facts, assess potential impact, and develop and track remediation plans with SOX leadership and accountable stakeholders.
* Coordinate with internal and external auditors and support requests related to SOX, internal controls, and financial reporting.
* Explain control requirements, findings, and recommendations to process owners, peer groups, and leaders; build cooperation and influence timely action across functions.
* Monitor progress against commitments, resolve routine execution issues, and escalate significant risks, delays, or resource needs.

**Governance and continuous improvement**

* Stay current on relevant SOX, PCAOB, COSO, U.S. GAAP, and public-company reporting requirements and emerging practices.
* Recommend updates to team procedures and control practices based on changes in the business, systems, risks, and applicable requirements.

**Here Is Some Of What You Will Need (required)**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* (10-12) years of related experience in accounting, external or internal audit, SOX, or internal controls, preferably across public accounting and corporate environments.
* Experience directly managing or formally leading employees, including assigning work, coaching, providing feedback, and supporting performance and development.
* Working knowledge of SOX 404, internal control frameworks such as COSO, audit requirements including PCAOB standards, and U.S. GAAP.
* Experience assessing business process risks, designing or evaluating controls, leading walkthroughs and control testing, documenting results, and driving remediation.
* Ability to analyze complex or incomplete information, exercise sound judgment, and interpret requirements to recommend appropriate procedures and actions.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical control matters and gain cooperation from cross-functional partners.
* Demonstrated ability to organize team work, manage multiple timelines, and deliver against recurring plans

**Here Are a Few Of Our Preferred Experiences**

* CPA, CIA, or other relevant professional certification.
* Experience supporting a public company’s SOX program through growth, system implementation, acquisition, or process transformation.
* Experience with internal controls over financial reporting across finance, accounting, IT, or operational processes.

**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as #3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the #1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The
*Manager , Collections Strategy Delivery Build*
role is responsible for implementation of Collection strategies as they relate to Pre-Delinquent, Delinquent (pre-charge off) & Recovery accounts utilizing SAS, Experian Power Curve (Strategy Manager) and Fiserv Rules. The Analyst leads solution development with build team, direct manager and change requestor for new projects, new clients and Strategy Change Initiatives within Strategy Delivery Team. Analysis of collection strategies and development/ enhancement of Phone and Alternate channel implementation processes are key elements to the success of the Strategy Delivery Team. Participates on multiple initiatives as Build SME for SAS, Strategy Manager application and Fiserv Rules Platform. As a Manager, you are required to be proficient in handing projects and engaging with stakeholders independently.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implements Collections and Operational Strategy initiatives for all delinquent accounts and Strategy designated Pre-Delinquent & Recovery accounts leveraging leading edge technology to enhance customer experience.
* Partner with collections contact strategy team, collection operations and process owners to determine strategy implementation requirements and develop / ensure streamlined approaches to coding, unit testing and queuing process
* Works independently to provide Level of Effort for scoping and scheduling the change requests
* Project Manager / SME for collections projects involving Alternate channel strategies (SAS) and Phone channel strategies (Strategy manager processes)
* Provides recommendations for process enhancements based upon Design Reviews
* Develop and monitor dashboards including analysis, action plans and identification of process improvements support simplification strategies including life-cycle tools and treatments specific to champion/challenger strategies that include digital channels, and other outbound correspondence
* Partners with process owners in establishing procedures and requirements to ensure accurate and timely delivery with regulatory and compliance standards
* Partners with Collections Data Warehouse team and Enterprise Data Lake teams for issue resolution
* Provide account level research for understanding of Collection processing
* Work independently with minimum to moderate supervision
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience
* Minimum 2 + years of hands-on experience with SAS or knowledge of SAS programming
* Minimum 2 + years of experience with design, test and control environments working with large amounts of data
* Minimum 1+ years analytical and decision-making experience.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* 1 year of experience with FISERV/FD Rules/ Strategy Manager Development (batch mode)
* 1 year of Project Management Experience
* Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects concurrently with commitment to deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and present business results to management

title: Systems Analyst
description:
**About Xerox Holdings Corporation**
For more than 100 years, Xerox has continually redefined the workplace experience. Harnessing our leadership position in office and production print technology, we’ve expanded into software and services to sustainably power the hybrid workplace of today and tomorrow. Today, Xerox is continuing its legacy of innovation to deliver client-centric and digitally-driven technology solutions and meet the needs of today’s global, distributed workforce. From the office to industrial environments, our differentiated business and technology offerings and financial services are essential workplace technology solutions that drive success for our clients. At Xerox, we make work, work. Learn more about us at www.xerox.com.
  
  
**Job Function:**
The role is responsible for the technical delivery, data architecture, and operational support of Channel Data Management (CDM) solutions within a complex enterprise environment, with a strong focus on database design, SQL development, and ETL processes.
  
  
This position defines and delivers high‑value CDM enhancements while ensuring data integrity, system performance, and scalability. The role requires deep expertise in relational databases, data modeling, and query optimization, as well as hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines to support data ingestion, transformation, and integration across multiple systems.
  
  
This position partners closely with IT, Sales Operations, and Data Engineering teams to manage end-to-end data solutions—from requirements gathering and backlog prioritization to data pipeline development, production support, and analytics enablement. The role ensures high-quality, reliable data flows across platforms while translating complex technical and data concepts into actionable insights for both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  
  
The CDM System Analyst should be highly motivated and passionate about data systems, database technologies, and scalable application architecture. The ideal candidate brings strong experience in SQL scripting, data transformation logic, performance tuning, and troubleshooting data issues across distributed systems. This role requires full ownership of data processes and pipelines, with a commitment to continuously enhancing the CDM ecosystem, improving data quality, and strengthening application and data infrastructure resiliency.
  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* System Operations, Monitoring & Incident Management
* Provide technical expertise to manage and support complex IT architectures supporting CDM solutions.
* Perform daily CDM system monitoring, including data validation, batch/job execution, and overall system health.
* Troubleshoot and resolve data quality and system issues identified through monitoring activities.
* Manage incidents and changes in alignment with the ITIL framework, including escalation to IT teams and tracking through resolution.
* Maintain, test, and continuously improve business and system operations to ensure stability and performance of 24x7 applications.
* Processes, Technical Solutions, Data & Analytics Enablement
* Support CDM Operations, Geo Sales Operations, and Data-to-Value teams with issue resolution, data loads, mass data updates, and technical guidance.
* Develop SQL-based solutions to support reporting and analytics needs, including Power BI datasets and reports.
* Build and maintain Business Objects Universes and reports.
* Design and deliver solutions using Microsoft Power BI and Power Platform tools.
* Maintain a holistic view of CDM processes and users to assess functional impacts across configuration, workflows, integrations, and reporting.
* Apply deep understanding of CDM business processes and related enterprise systems, including ERP, PLM, CRM, and the Microsoft ecosystem.
* Stakeholder Collaboration, Communication & Enablement
* Work closely with technology and operations teams to ensure successful, sustainable delivery of CDM systems, including transitions to IT operations.
* Provide regular project and operational updates (weekly/monthly), and confidently brief executive audiences to support informed, proactive decision-making.
* Report risks, issues, and progress to IT leadership, escalating as appropriate.
* Develop, deliver, and support training for CDM operations and key user teams, enabling adoption and effective system usage.
* Effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Experience and Background:**
**Work History:**

* 5+ years of experience in designing solutions and defining requirements for CDM platforms and complex IT systems, including hands-on experience with databases, SQL, ETL processes, and related data systems..
* Excellent communication skills and customer service skills
* Must have strong problem-solving ability, critical thinking skills, creative/innovative thinking, attention to detail, and previous systems/business analyst experience.
* Must show positive attitude, strong self-motivation, ability to meet deadlines, and ability to determine appropriate sense of urgency.
* Good understanding of software development life cycles.

**Technical Competence:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Information Systems or closely related field.
* Expertise in Data warehouse and ETL tools like BODS (Business Objects Data Services), DataStage, Business Objects, AWS Aurora and AWS Redshift.
* Must have knowledge in IT Development, Production support or Operations area.
* Extensive working experience in SQL Query or other programming languages.
* Must have knowledge in Microsoft office tools, particularly Excel, VBA and Access.
* Nice to have knowledge of web applications, portals and document management tools.
* Nice to have knowledge of webMethods or any such integration tools.
* Nice to have knowledge of SAP HANA, Microsoft D365, Enovia or similar tools in ERP, CRM and PLM.
* Nice to have knowledge in Power Platform apps, Power BI, Power App, Power Automate/ Flow.
* Experience in project management skills.

**Skills:**

* Oral & Written Communication.
* Strong problem solving, critical thinking
* Ability to be a global team player, communicate and work well in a collaborative environment.
* Be proactive in resolving issues and delivering business solutions.

* Process Facilitation.

title: Business Coach, Amazon, VAS-Category
description:
**Description**
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses during a transformational time.
  
  
The Business Coach finds and executes value-creation opportunities and manages the DSP relationship across the entire lifecycle of the business. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs to help solve their biggest challenges at a programmatic level; influence their business planning and strategy; and look around corners to identify obstacles and recommend solutions, ensuring DSP owners make effective business decisions and are setup for success.
  
  
Our Business Coaches are leaders and collaborators. They are analytical and creative; deadline-driven, organized and able to multi-task; and have strong interpersonal skills including a demonstrated ability to earn trust, inspire others, and be empathetic. You’ll be at the center of cross-functional teams, all working together to deliver the highest quality experience to Amazon customers.
  
  
If you're a dynamic, organized self-starter who’s ready to partner with our DSP owners as they launch and scale their business in one of the fastest growing industries in the world, we’d like to talk with you. Curious? Good, that’s one of our Leadership Principles! Discover more about the opportunity below.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**On a Daily Basis, Business Coaches Are Responsible For**
Supporting owners as they onboard to the program and prepare to launch.
  
  
Guiding owners as they scale their business and manage operational issues, ensuring they have resources in place to effectively ramp-up operations and prepare for peak periods.
  
  
Coordinating Business and Financial Health Reviews to discuss business performance and new opportunities, as well as to provide benchmarking data and insights.
  
  
Identifying workflow inefficiencies and working to formulate and implement operational improvements at the network level and to improve the individual DSP owner experience.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
As a Business Coach, you will partner with 20-40 DSP owners assigned to delivery stations across IN. You’ll work closely with a portfolio of owners at different stages as they set strategy, help drive accountability and engagement, and motivate and track key performance metrics. You’ll collaborate with an integrated internal team of Station Operations Managers, Program Managers, and Compliance and Finance personnel to ensure owners launch and scale their business in compliance with program requirements. Together, you’ll provide best-in-class support for owners by removing obstacles and improving financial, operational, and safety practices at the network level. You’ll accomplish this by analyzing problems, discovering insights, delivering recommendations, and driving change both internally and externally.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of employee and performance management experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

+ OTC (Order to Cash)
+ P2P (Procure to Pay)
+ R2R (Record to Report)
+ Manufacturing / Digital Supply Chain

* Technical & Process Capabilities

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking abilities to navigate complex business workflows.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience presenting solutions to business stakeholders.
* Strong team player capable of working effectively in multi-disciplinary project teams.

* SAP Certification: Official SAP Certified Application Associate – SAP Transportation Management.
* Exposure to integrated S/4HANA Supply Chain modules (e.g., EWM, SD, MM).
* Prior experience with data migration tools and data loading processes.

title: SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant
description:
Job Description: Senior SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant
  
  
Position Overview
  
  

* Position: Senior SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant
* Experience Required: 8 to 10+ years
* Location / Mode: PAN India / Hybrid
* Project Type: Implementation, Roll-outs, Support, Change Requests, and Enhancements

Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic
**Senior SAP Controlling (CO) Consultant**
with a strong track record of end-to-end implementations and business process re-engineering. The ideal candidate possesses deep expertise across core and advanced SAP CO modules, exceptional stakeholder communication skills, and hands-on experience in SAP S/4HANA environments. You will lead requirement gathering, solution building, gap analysis, and month-end closing cycles while coordinating closely with technical teams.
  
  
**Mandatory Requirements & Core Skills**

* Experience: 8–10+ years of cumulative IT experience specializing in SAP Controlling (CO).
* Communication: EXCELLENT verbal and written communication skills with proven ability in client-facing roles, blueprinting, and user training.
* SAP S/4HANA Knowledge: Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA differences compared to ECC (e.g., Universal Journal integration, Material Ledger enhancements, CO-PA architecture).
* Project Lifecycle: Hands-on participation in at least 2+ full-cycle implementations, roll-outs, or major support/enhancement projects from requirement gathering to Go-Live.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Core SAP CO Modules:

+ General Controlling, Cost Center Accounting (CO-OM-CCA), and Profit Center Accounting (EC-PCA).
+ Product Costing (CO-PC) covering Make-to-Stock (MTS) and Make-to-Order (MTO) scenarios.
+ Material Ledger (ML) and profitability analysis (CO-PA), including Report Painter, CO-PA Realignment, and Top-Down Distribution.

* Month-End Closing Excellence: Expert execution and troubleshooting of month-end closing tasks in CO, including Work in Process (WIP) calculation, Variance Analysis, and Order/Project Settlement.
* Specialized CO Scenarios:

+ Overhead management (Overhead keys, Overhead groups).
+ Advanced costing methods: Additive costing, Job costing, Batch costing, Mixed costing, Joint product, By-product, and Co-product costing.
+ Origin groups and Auxiliary Cost Component structures.

* Cross-Functional Integration: Seamless integration of SAP CO with FI, MM, SD, PP, and PM modules, alongside integration with BW or BI.
* Project Delivery & Methodology:

+ Lead Business Process Re-engineering (BPR), Solution Building, Blueprinting, and GAP Analysis.
+ Design and execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and prepare comprehensive user manuals and training documentation.
+ Manage and prioritize multiple assignments simultaneously to meet rigorous delivery schedules.

* Technical Coordination & Interfaces: Collaborate with technical teams for custom object development, and handle interface configurations including RFC connections and Background Job Tools.

* Drive batch traceability, reefer service and chilled service strategies.

By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth. You will collaborate with subject matter experts to deliver training needs analysis, curriculum design, and blended training solutions, using industry-standard tools to create engaging learning assets. Your ability to adapt to changing priorities and work across time zones will validate seamless project execution and client satisfaction.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Designing and implementing learning solutions to support client transformation initiatives
* Collaborating with Subject Matter Experts to conduct Training Needs Analysis and develop curriculum
* Utilizing instructional design frameworks such as ADDIE and SAM to create engaging learning experiences

* Evaluating learning program effectiveness using Kirkpatrick Levels 1-3 and refining based on feedback
* Supporting engagement delivery through phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation
* Facilitating workshops and presentations using various collaboration tools
* Providing guidance and mentorship to junior team members to enhance their development
* Staying informed on the latest trends in learning and development to contribute to internal initiatives
* Developing and presenting innovative ideas and solutions to clients and stakeholders
* Building and maintaining client relationships to support organizational change management efforts
* Analyzing business operations and ERP solutions to align learning strategies with organizational goals

* 4-8 years of prior relevant experience in consulting

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 2 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* An interest in upskilling for a digital world and technology trends, an openness to learning new tools and adapting how you work.

* Exhibiting ability to work independently and in teams
* Supporting client-facing consulting engagements and mentoring juniors

**About Kass**

Kass is a premium D2C skincare brand built around
**Bio-Intelligent Skincare -**
thoughtfully formulated solutions designed to address skin concerns at their foundation and support long-term skin health.Building a premium brand goes far beyond creating pretty graphics. It requires a distinctive visual language, a cohesive brand ecosystem, and high-velocity operational pipelines that consistently deliver theatrical-grade assets. We are looking for a
**Creative/Design Head**
who understands how modern, premium D2C brands operate, commands the production floor, and knows how to lead a multidisciplinary creative department to drive tangible brand scale.

**The Role**

As the
**Creative/Design Head**
, you will own Kass’s entire visual and creative direction across all touchpoints - digital performance campaigns, brand films, 3D simulations, physical packaging, and retail presence.You will lead, mentor, and direct a high-output multidisciplinary team (video editors, 3D motion artists and graphic designers), acting as the ultimate strategic and aesthetic filter for the brand. Beyond creative leadership, you will build and optimize the operational pipelines and automations that allow the team to scale output without sacrificing a premium, "million-dollar" brand finish.

**Key Responsibilities1. Creative Direction & Brand Architecture**

* **Define, protect, and evolve**
  Kass’s overall visual identity and brand guidelines across digital, physical packaging, e-commerce, and offline touchpoints.
* **Translate complex, clinical, and bio-intelligent formulations**
  into sophisticated, scroll-stopping narratives and high-converting visual assets.
* Ensure every frame, static, and render meets an uncompromising, premium aesthetic standard.

**2. Multidisciplinary Team Leadership**

* **Direct, mentor, and maintain rigorous quality control**
  over a high-output creative floor comprising Video Editors, Graphic Designers and 3D Motion Artists.
* **Act as the primary strategic filter**
  for all campaigns—reviewing daily cuts, static creatives, narrative hooks, and 3D explainers to eliminate friction before deployment.
* **Plan, delegate, and manage project workflows**
  based on priorities, launch timelines, and individual strengths, fostering a culture of ownership and execution speed.

**3. Production & On-Set Command**

* **Bridge practical filmmaking with digital post-production**
  —lead on-set shoots, direct macro camera setups and lighting, and establish a rich, organic visual vocabulary for new product drops.
* **Supervise high-fidelity post-production**
  , including dynamic motion tracking, kinetic typography, and seamless 3D/CGI product integration.
* **Lead the production**
  of both top-of-funnel cinematic brand films and rapid-iteration performance creatives (Reels, Meta ads, short-form video).

**4. Pipeline Architecture & Workflow Optimization**

* **Build, maintain, and streamline**
  the department’s operational backbone, designing organizational systems and workflows that eliminate creative bottlenecks.
* **Integrate modern automation tools**
  , node-based workflows, and emerging AI technologies into daily production to exponentially scale asset variations and multiply team efficiency.
* **Collaborate closely**
  with Marketing, Performance, Product, and Operations to translate commercial goals into actionable creative solutions with minimal turnaround time.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Proven Leadership:**
  Demonstrated track record leading, managing, and mentoring a multidisciplinary creative or design team in a high-velocity environment (D2C, agency, or high-growth consumer brand).
* **Aesthetic & Technical Mastery:**
  Advanced proficiency across Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator) with strong working knowledge of 3D workflows, motion graphics, and emerging AI creative tools.
* **On-Set Production Eye:**
  Solid understanding of cinematography, lighting, framing, and macro product shooting.
* **Systems Thinker:**
  Someone who doesn’t just design, but builds scalable pipelines, templates, and automated workflows to elevate the entire department’s output.
* **D2C Performance Sense:**
  Deep intuition for modern consumer psychology, thumb-stopping hooks, retention pacing, and conversion-focused design.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Fine Arts, Design, Animation, Visual Communication, or an equivalent battle-tested industry portfolio.

**Why Kass?**

At Kass, creative production is not an afterthought—it is the central engine of our brand equity and customer acquisition. If you have the vision to shape a rapidly scaling skincare brand and the operational muscle to lead a high-performing creative floor, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Partnerships & Activations Lead
description:
**Job Title: Partnerships & Activations Lead**

**Location:**
Kolkata

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, work from office, with local travel

**Preferred Experience:**
3–5 years in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, brand activations or business development

**About Sevora**

Sevora is a stylist-led fashion shopping platform offering curated fashion, personal shopping assistance, Try at Home and express delivery in eligible locations. We help customers discover and purchase outfits with confidence and convenience.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a relationship-driven professional to build partnerships and deliver community activations that generate qualified leads, shopping appointments and sales.

You will develop a network across Kolkata’s residential communities, clubs, private social groups and complementary businesses. Working closely with Sales and the Personal Shopper, you will own partner acquisition, activation planning, execution, lead quality and cost efficiency.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Partnerships & Community Development**

* Build relationships with community hosts, residential associations, premium clubs, women’s groups and event organisers.
* Establish referral partnerships with salons, beauty studios, wedding planners, makeup artists and complementary lifestyle businesses.
* Develop partnership proposals and negotiate participation fees, promotional support, collaboration terms and referral arrangements.
* Maintain an active partner pipeline and monthly activation calendar.
* Develop productive partnerships into recurring shopping events and referral opportunities.

**2. Lead Generation & Appointment Booking**

* Deliver monthly targets for qualified customer leads and shopping appointments.
* Generate enquiries through kitty parties, private gatherings, residential communities, clubs, curated exhibitions, professional networks and referrals.
* Prepare channel plans with target audiences, activities, budgets and expected outcomes.
* Capture shopping preferences, budget, occasion, buying timeline and location to support lead qualification.
* Develop customer and community-host referral programmes with approved incentives and clear tracking.

**3. Activations & Event Execution**

* Plan and execute private shopping sessions, styling events, collection previews, pop-ups and community activations.
* Evaluate opportunities based on audience fit, purchase intent, participation costs and sales potential.
* Own event logistics, including permissions, venue arrangements, setup, displays, staffing coordination and partner communication.
* Coordinate invitations, lookbooks, QR codes, registration forms and promotional materials with Marketing and Creative teams.
* Coordinate assortment, stock availability, product movement and reconciliation with Merchandising and Operations.
* Work with Sales and the Personal Shopper to deliver shopping assistance and introduce eligible customers to Try at Home.
* Manage approved budgets and maintain records of expenses and partner commitments.

**4. Lead Handover & Sales Coordination**

* Capture accurate customer details and permission for follow-up.
* Record lead source, preferences, interest level and next action in the CRM.
* Hand over leads promptly to Sales with clear ownership and follow-up expectations.
* Review appointment attendance, follow-up progress, purchases and reasons for lost sales.
* Coordinate post-event follow-ups with Sales and retention campaigns with CRM.
* Use customer and sales feedback to improve future activations.

**5. Performance & Reporting**

* Report weekly on partner outreach, confirmed activities, qualified leads, appointments, costs and attributable sales.
* Track performance by partner, event and referral source using CRM tags, QR links or referral codes.
* Monitor cost per qualified lead, cost per purchasing customer and sales after cancellations and returns.
* Assess activation profitability with Finance using product margins and relevant costs.
* Recommend which partnerships and activities to expand, improve or discontinue.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Relevant experience in partnerships, community marketing, retail marketing, activations or business development.
* Strong networking, negotiation, presentation and relationship-management skills.
* Experience generating customer leads and delivering measurable commercial outcomes.
* Ability to manage activities independently, from outreach and planning to execution and reporting.
* Understanding of budgets, lead qualification, conversion and customer acquisition costs.
* Clear communication in Bengali, Hindi and English.
* Comfort using spreadsheets, presentations, WhatsApp Business and CRM tools.
* Willingness to travel within Kolkata and support scheduled evening or weekend events.

**Preferred Background**

Experience in fashion, premium retail, beauty, hospitality or lifestyle services. Existing relationships with Kolkata communities, clubs, residential associations and relevant businesses will be an advantage.

**Position:**
Senior QS & Billing Expert
  
  
**Experience:**
10+ Years
  
  
**Qualification:**
Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering (B.E./B.Tech) from a recognized university.
  
  
**Location:**
Railway Project Site
  
  
Role Purpose
  
  
The Senior QS & Billing Expert will be responsible for quantity surveying, measurement, billing, cost monitoring, contract administration, and commercial management of railway civil infrastructure works, ensuring accurate billing and compliance with contract conditions, specifications, and project requirements.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Review and verify contractor measurements, RA bills, final bills, and supporting documents.
* Prepare and check detailed quantities, BOQs, rate analysis, and cost estimates for civil and railway infrastructure works.
* Monitor quantities executed at site and reconcile them with approved drawings, BOQ, and contract provisions.
* Conduct joint measurements with contractors and site teams and maintain accurate measurement records.
* Review variation claims, extra items, deviation statements, and rate analysis for additional works.
* Monitor project costs, quantities, and expenditure against the approved budget and contract value.
* Assist in contract administration, including interpretation of BOQ, specifications, payment terms, and contractual provisions.
* Review contractor submissions related to claims, extensions of time, escalation, and other commercial matters.
* Coordinate with engineering, planning, construction, and project management teams for timely resolution of billing and quantity-related issues.
* Maintain records of measurements, bills, variations, quantities, and commercial correspondence.
* Prepare monthly commercial reports, cost statements, quantity reconciliation, and billing status reports.
* Ensure compliance with project specifications, contract conditions, Indian Railways/RDSO requirements, and applicable standards.
* Support the Project Manager in commercial and contractual matters related to railway civil works.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of Quantity Surveying, billing, measurement, BOQ, rate analysis, and cost control.
* Good understanding of civil construction contracts and contract administration.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, AutoCAD, and quantity/billing software.
* Ability to independently verify contractor bills and assess quantities at site.
* Strong analytical, numerical, documentation, and reporting skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills with contractors and project stakeholders.
* Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary project environment.

**Preferred Experience**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in Quantity Surveying, Billing, Cost Control, or Commercial Management.
* Experience in railway/metro infrastructure projects will be preferred.
* Experience in civil works such as railway formation, earthwork, bridges, culverts, stations, drainage, and other infrastructure works.
* Experience in EPC/Item Rate/Construction Contracts, contractor billing, variations, claims, and final account settlement.
* Knowledge of Indian Railways, RDSO, Metro Rail standards, SOR/DSR, and railway contract procedures will be an advantage.

Key Deliverables
  
  

* Accurate and timely verification of contractor bills and measurements.
* Effective monitoring and reconciliation of quantities and project costs.
* Proper assessment and documentation of variations, claims, and additional works.
* Timely commercial and billing reports for project management.
* Compliance with contractual, technical, and financial requirements.
* Effective support to project management in QS, billing, and contract administration matters.

title: Member
description:
**Company Description**
MeHAN is a human-centered advisory firm focused on closing the gap between buying AI tools and actually using them effectively in organizations. Instead of traditional button-click training, MeHAN addresses the real barriers to AI adoption, such as fear, resistance, leadership gaps, and cultural signals. The company uses diagnostic, data-driven insights tailored to each client’s unique context, avoiding generic best practices. Built specifically for India’s mid-market companies with 100 to 2,000 employees, MeHAN follows a structured four-step process from free pulse checks to custom programs that measurably improve AI adoption. Applicants join a team committed to making AI investments meaningful, practical, and measurable for clients.
  
**Role Description**
As a Member at MeHAN, you will work full time on-site in the Greater Kolkata Area, contributing to diagnostic-led advisory projects that help clients improve AI adoption. You will support the design and delivery of pulse checks and team-wide diagnostics, gather and interpret organizational data, and help translate findings into clear, actionable insights for client teams. You will collaborate with colleagues to shape custom programs that address behavioral, cultural, and leadership barriers to AI usage, and assist in tracking impact and adoption metrics over time. The role involves direct interaction with client stakeholders, participation in workshops and discussions, and ongoing documentation and reporting to ensure clarity, consistency, and measurable outcomes.
  
**Qualifications**

* Ability to understand organizational behavior, culture, and change dynamics, and apply these insights to improve technology adoption.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including experience working with diagnostic data, surveys, or structured assessments.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present findings and recommendations to diverse stakeholder groups.
* Comfort working in client-facing environments, with skills in collaboration, facilitation, and building trust across teams.

title: SAP PM CS
description:
Job Description: SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking a highly experienced and results-driven
**SAP S/4HANA Service Management Lead / Senior Functional Consultant**
with
**5 to 12 years**
of expertise across SAP Customer Service (CS), Service Management (SM), and S/4HANA Service.
  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for designing, configuring, and implementing end-to-end Service Management processes in an
**SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition (PCE) / RISE with SAP**
environment. You will bridge business requirements and functional architecture, manage cloud service governance, enable AI-driven service insights, and drive continuous optimization across the full service lifecycle.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Solution Design & Implementation
* Design, configure, and deploy S/4HANA Service Management processes across the entire service lifecycle: Engage, Sell, Contract, Plan, Schedule, Execute, Invoice, and Analyze.
* Map end-to-end business requirements to standard S/4HANA Service capabilities, including service quotations, service orders, service contracts, spare parts logistics, resource planning, billing, and analytics.
* Drive adoption of the latest S/4HANA PCE release innovations (e.g., service team determination, advanced execution processes, Fiori applications, and AI-powered service intelligence).
* S/4HANA Private Edition (PCE) Governance
* Operate effectively within the SAP S/4HANA PCE Shared Responsibility Model between the client and SAP Enterprise Cloud Services (ECS).
* Liaise with SAP for system-level operational tasks (e.g., infrastructure management, backups, maintenance, and upgrade administration).
* Lead client-side functional responsibilities, including business process configuration, functional validation, regression testing, and process governance based on SAP’s PCE Roles and Responsibilities framework.
* Service Order & Contract Management
* Configure and maintain service contract structures, recurring service billing plans, and auto-renewal mechanisms.
* Enable flexible billing scenarios, including Resource-Related Billing (RRB), Time & Material (T&M), and Fixed-Price billing models.
* Leverage modern platform features such as service contract template cloning and mass contract change capabilities.
* Service Planning, Execution & Logistics Integration
* Set up and optimize workforce planning, resource allocation, dispatching, and field service workflows.
* Configure plant and storage location parameters within service transactions to support multi-plant and multi-location service execution.
* Direct cross-module functional integration between service transactions and procurement (MM), inventory management, shipping, plant maintenance (PM), and follow-on financial postings.
* Data Migration, Testing & Integration
* Oversee data preparation, cleansing, transformation, and validation for service master data, active service contracts, and open service orders.
* Utilize the SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit and standard transition tools tailored for service artifacts.
* Coordinate functional and technical integrations across CRM, SAP Field Service Management (FSM), SAP CS, core logistics, and Finance (FI/CO).
* AI, Analytics & Continuous Process Improvement
* Implement embedded AI capabilities (e.g., Joule-assisted summaries, intelligent confirmations, and predictive service insights).
* Design custom Fiori dashboards, operational reports, and KPIs to monitor service performance and profitability.
* Guide business stakeholders through continuous improvement initiatives and the adoption of periodic SAP release features.
* Stakeholder Management & Documentation
* Facilitate requirements-gathering workshops, author detailed functional specifications (FS), and map target-state business process flows.
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Logistics, Procurement, Finance, and Sales.
* Create training collateral, deliver end-user training, and lead hypercare support during deployment phases.

**Required Skills & Technical Expertise**

* Experience: 5–12 years of hands-on experience in SAP CS / SM / S/4HANA Service functional consulting.
* Core Module Competency: Comprehensive knowledge of S/4HANA Service (PCE) core functionality (Service Orders, Service Contracts, Resource-Related Billing, Invoicing, and Execution Logistics).
* Cloud Architecture: Clear operational understanding of the SAP PCE operating model, RISE with SAP frameworks, and cloud service boundary matrices.
* User Experience & Extensibility: Proficiency with modern SAP Fiori apps, standard OData APIs, and functional extensibility options.
* Integration Touchpoints: Strong cross-functional integration experience with PM, SD, MM, FI/CO, and SAP FSM.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Practical project experience with RISE with SAP S/4HANA Cloud, Private Edition implementations or migrations.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP upgrade governance and release management protocols in PCE environments.
* Official SAP Certification in S/4HANA Service or related SAP functional modules.

**Soft Skills**

* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong consulting mindset with a proven ability to translate business strategy into technical solution designs.
* Proactive problem-solving capabilities and experience leading cross-functional delivery teams.

title: SAP CCM
description:
Job Description: SAP CCM
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**SAP Functional Lead / Senior Consultant**
with
**8 to 10 years**
of hands-on expertise across Application Maintenance (AM) support and Application Development (AD)/enhancements. The ideal candidate will possess deep specialization in
**SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)**
—including rebate processing, accruals, and settlement logic—backed by robust knowledge of
**SAP SD and Pricing**
.
  
  
In this role, you will lead complex enhancements, drive continuous process improvements, and provide robust L2/L3 production support in an S/4HANA enterprise environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Enhancements & Application Development (AD)**

* Process Enhancement & Delivery: Lead the design and delivery of CCM enhancements, including new condition contract types, specialized settlement logic, and custom rebate models tailored to evolving business requirements.
* Functional Specifications: Gather business requirements and translate them into comprehensive Functional Specifications (FS) for custom RICEF objects.
* System Configuration: Configure condition contract types, pricing conditions, settlement parameters, and cross-module integration points.
* Development & Testing: Partner closely with technical (ABAP) teams through development, unit testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure defect-free production releases.
* Continuous Improvement: Drive process optimization and automation initiatives within CCM and pricing operational workflows.

**Application Maintenance & Production Support (AM)**

* L2/L3 Incident Management: Deliver high-quality L2/L3 support for SAP S/4HANA CCM operations, ensuring strict adherence to SLAs and minimal business disruption.
* Troubleshooting & Resolution: Analyze and resolve complex issues related to rebate processing, settlement runs, accrual postings, and pricing discrepancies.
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Perform in-depth RCA on recurring defects and implement permanent preventive fixes.
* ITSM Governance: Efficiently manage incidents, problem records, and service requests within ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow).
* Period-End Operations: Monitor, validate, and support period-end settlement runs and corresponding financial postings.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance**

* Integration Alignment: Collaborate with SD and FI teams to resolve complex, cross-module integration issues and ensure seamless Order-to-Cash (O2C) processing.
* Change Management: Adhere strictly to change management, transport release, and governance protocols for all system enhancements.
* Knowledge Management: Maintain detailed functional documentation, conduct Knowledge Transfer (KT) sessions, and promote standard SAP best practices.

**Required Candidate Profile**

* Experience: 8–10 years of SAP hands-on experience covering both Application Support (AMS) and Enhancements/Implementations in SAP S/4HANA environments.
* Core Functional Expertise: Deep domain expertise in SAP Condition Contract Management (CCM)—rebates, accruals, settlements, and contract maintenance.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid expertise in SAP SD (Order-to-Cash) and advanced SAP Pricing Procedure configurations.
* Technical Interface Skills: Proven track record of designing functional specs for custom RICEF objects and working with ABAP teams.
* Support Proficiency: Familiarity with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow) and standard ITIL support processes.

title: Consultant- Transport
description:
**Role Objective**
To ensure seamless, safe, and efficient crew transport operations at Indigo’s new airport locations by managing vendor relationships, leveraging automation tools, maintaining high safety standards, and generating actionable MIS reports. The role demands operational agility, tech-savviness, and strong stakeholder coordination.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Transport Operations Management
* Oversee end-to-end crew transport operations including scheduling, dispatching, routing, and real-time tracking.
* Ensure punctual and reliable pick-up/drop-off of crew members between airport, residences, and hotels.
* Coordinate with crew scheduling and rostering teams to align transport plans with flight operations.
* Vendor Management
* Manage multiple transport vendors under contractual agreements.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and audits of vendors based on KPIs such as punctuality, vehicle condition, driver behavior, and compliance.
* Negotiate service terms, resolve disputes, and ensure adherence to Indigo’s operational standards.
* Automation & Technology Integration
* Implement and manage transport automation tools (e.g., GPS tracking, Dashboard cameras, crew transport apps, automated dispatch systems).
* Collaborate with IT and operations teams to enhance digital workflows and reduce manual dependencies.
* Monitor dashboards for real-time transport status and exception handling.
* Safety & Compliance
* Ensure all vehicles and drivers comply with Indigo’s safety protocols and regulatory norms (RTO, PVC, etc.).
* Conduct periodic safety drills, vehicle inspections, and driver training sessions.
* Maintain documentation for audits, insurance, and incident reporting.
* MIS & Reporting
* Generate daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports covering transport utilization, cost analysis, vendor performance, and incident logs.
* Analyze data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement.
* Present insights to senior management for strategic decision-making.
* Stakeholder Coordination
* Act as the primary point of contact for crew members regarding transport-related queries and escalations.
* Liaise with airport operations, HR, and finance teams for smooth coordination and budget alignment.
* Support onboarding of new crew members with transport orientation.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Graduate in any discipline; preference for candidates with specialization in logistics, transport management, or aviation operations.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in transport/logistics operations, preferably in aviation, hospitality, or fleet management.
* Strong understanding of transport automation tools and MIS systems.
* Excellent vendor management, negotiation, and analytical skills.
* Proficient in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and transport management software.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to work in rotational shifts, including weekends and holidays.
* Ideal candidate must be staying in near proximity of the airport.

* Define and review migration requirements for customer accounts, billing accounts, products, services, balances, open items and billing history.
* Support data mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, mock migration, parallel billing, cutover and post-migration validation activities.
* Define and deliver solution designs, interface specifications, test strategies, test cases and migration-reconciliation reports for billing completeness and accuracy.
* Support system integration testing, end-to-end testing, user acceptance testing, bill validation, cutover rehearsals and production support.

* 4–8 years of experience in telecom BSS, with significant techno-functional, hands-on experience in billing and revenue management.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major billing platform such as Aria Billing Cloud, Ericsson Billing, Netcracker Revenue Management or an equivalent platform. Hands-on experience on Aria Billing will be a definitive advantage.
* Strong understanding of the telecom billing lifecycle, including customer and billing-account management, product and pricing configuration, usage processing, rating, recurring and one-time charges, bill calculation, invoicing, taxation, payments, adjustments, collections and dunning.
* Hands-on proficiency in Java, XML, SQL, APIs, data-analysis tools and cloud environments is required.
* Should be willing to work in shifts
* Experience migrating customers, accounts, products, subscriptions, balances and billing history from one billing platform to another.
* Knowledge of billing data profiling, mapping, cleansing, mock migrations, financial reconciliation, parallel billing, fallout management and cutover validation.
* Experience in production support or managed services for billing products, including incident, problem, change and release management; bill-cycle monitoring; root-cause analysis; defect resolution; and SLA-based support.
* Understanding of integrations between billing and CRM, order management, mediation, charging, product catalog, payment, tax, ERP/general ledger, customer-care and reporting platforms.
* Working knowledge of TM Forum eTOM, SID, Open Digital Architecture and Open APIs, particularly billing-account and customer-bill management.
* Experience preparing functional specifications, process flows, business requirements, user stories, solution-design inputs and test scenarios.
* Experience in leveraging latest AI tools to deliver projects within time, budget and quality.
* A bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, business systems or a related discipline.
* Relevant TM Forum or billing-product certifications are an advantage.

**What We Look For**
Highly motivated telecom billing professionals who combine strong domain knowledge with hands-on delivery experience. You should be able to analyze complex billing scenarios, translate requirements into practical solutions and support clients through transformation, migration and production support operations while maintaining a clear focus on billing accuracy, revenue integrity and customer outcomes.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Job Name- GDS Consulting - Microsoft Business Applications Leader - GTM, Delivery and Alliance Management**
**Position Summary**
Microsoft Alliance is part of EY's broader strategy to work with leading technology providers to deliver innovative solutions that help clients navigate the complexities of the digital world. Through such alliances, consulting is better equipped to support clients in achieving their strategic objectives and driving digital success. Microsoft Business Applications practice at GDS focuses on leveraging Microsoft's suite of business applications to help clients optimize their operations and transform their businesses.
  
  
To strengthen our capability and brand, the following are the underpinning aspects
  
  

* A world class global delivery capability on Microsoft Business Applications with focus on FS & non FS segments in areas – Americas,
* EMEIA and APAC
* The ability for GDS to own and drive strategic initiatives by playing an active role in various Fields of play for both G-360 & Core Accounts For FY 25 and beyond, Microsoft Business Application (Biz Apps) is seeing huge potential across domains like Finance, Risk, Supply Chain, HR and across both Financial & Commercial Sectors. The long-term goal is to expand its footprint in not just having capability but having significant presence in Sector Solutions and Field of Play offerings of EY. Microsoft Biz Apps Leader is needed at GDS to provide vision, drive growth, maintain excellence in delivery, and ensure that clients receive the best possible solutions to their business challenges using Microsoft technologies.

GDS Microsoft Biz Apps Leader will have responsibilities across following key focus areas,
  
  

* Leadership & Strategy

+ Define and execute a comprehensive strategy for Microsoft Business Applications, aligning with overall business goals and market opportunities.
+ Lead and mentor teams responsible for delivery, pre-sales, and solution architecture within the Microsoft Business Applications domain.
+ Drive organizational growth by leveraging Microsoft Business Apps as a core strategic pillar.

* Go-To-Market (GTM) Management

+ Develop and manage the GTM strategy for Microsoft Dynamics 365, Power Platform, and other Microsoft Business Apps, focusing on key growth opportunities.
+ Partner global and regional Microsoft Biz Apps champion to win large engagements from current deal $225 MN in FY 25 to $375 MN by FY 28 with YoY growth of 18%.
+ Collaborate with other partner firms within EY and establish value propositions and solutions that resonate with target clients.
+ Engage with clients to evangelize Microsoft Business Apps and address critical business needs.
+ Engage with Microsoft alliance partners to drive growth

* Delivery Management

+ Oversee the successful delivery of projects
+ Expand the GTM and Delivery team with mix of Associate Directors, Senior Manager, Managers and below with target team size of 650 by FY 28
+ Applications projects, ensuring timely execution, high quality, and client satisfaction.
+ Establish best practices for project delivery, including process improvements, risk management, and quality assurance.
+ Work closely with technical teams to ensure alignment with delivery goals and client requirements.

* Alliance & Partnership Management

+ Act as the primary liaison between EY and Microsoft, nurturing the alliance to maximize mutual benefits.
+ Identify opportunities for co-selling, joint initiatives, and strategic investments with Microsoft.
+ Maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across Microsoft and other relevant partners to enhance partnership performance.

* Technology Expertise

+ Demonstrate an in-depth understanding of Microsoft Business Applications, including Dynamics 365 (Sales, Finance, Supply Chain), Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate), and Azure.
+ Stay up to date with new features, releases, and advancements in the Microsoft ecosystem and communicate these insights effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.

* Business Growth & Innovation

+ Leverage your industry exp

**Essential Functions Of The Job**

* Leadership and team management, including talent acquisition, development, and retention
* Works with EY teams to ensure One Microsoft approach
* Develop and manage the GTM strategy for Microsoft Dynamics 365,
* Power Platform, and other Microsoft Business Apps, focusing on key growth opportunities.
* Technical oversight and quality assurance of deliverables
* Standardizes, simplifies, and modernizes the delivery practices
* Business development and client relationship management
* Financial management of the practice's operations

**Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities**

* Professional with the ability to make most of the decisions pertaining to practice growth, investment in new areas of technology and people issues
* Defining location strategy with respect to global locations, building integrated operating model, identifying right pricing, and acquiring local talent
* Sharp focus on building competitive cost of delivery
* Defining winning themes and building differentiated solutions

**Education & Experience**

* Minimum of bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, Information Systems Management, or a related field with 20 years of experience. Graduate from top colleges is a huge plus
* Microsoft certifications in Dynamics 365 and Power Platforms with technical delivery experience in Dynamics 365 CRM App, PowerApps,
* Power platform, Front and Back-office integrations, Microsoft Azure DevOps.
* Experience of managing practice/accounts with HC above 200+ would be a huge plus
* Demonstrated record in driving revenue within existing clients and in developing new prospects at the “C” level of Fortune 500 companies
* Demonstrated ability to work successfully within a matrixed organization and to enlist support and commitment from peers in selling and delivering advisory services.

**Knowledge And Skills Requirements**

* Technology expertise, in Microsoft solutions focused on D365 and power platforms, 20 years across roles spanning client delivery, innovation, solution architecting, people, and program management. At least last 10+ years in technical leadership roles
* Demonstrates Dynamics and Power Platform technical expertise including associated Microsoft stack implementation technologies such as Azure, SharePoint, and Exchange/Outlook, with a proven ability to sell and execute large scale consulting engagements with a distributed delivery mindset
* Strong reputation in the talent market and the ability to build a strong & continuous talent pipeline, based on one’s reputation and prior successes.
* Competitive intelligence about Big4 and Microsoft skills landscape
* Specialized industry-sector experience in at least one or two sectors relevant to EY like Consumer products & Retail, Technology, Media & Entertainment, Telecom, Advanced Manufacturing & Mobility, Oil and Gas, Government and infrastructure

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Lead / Senior Consultant to design, deliver, and optimize enterprise-grade D365 and Power Platform solutions. * Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.

* Solid knowledge of Power Platform including Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power BI.
