title: Project Control Specialist I
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

***As a Project Control Specialist II with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Lead and guide the Project Controls team for Schedule and Cost function on the Project.
* Work with Project leadership team in alignment and strategic discussions on the project.
* Develop and finalise the Project Controls Plan as per Project requirements and interface with Client and internal stakeholders.
* Lead and develop the Progress measurement system for the project based on the contractual reporting requirements and processes.
* Actively participate in Schedule development and guide the team to the required Planning and scheduling requirements.
* Conduct / lead Schedule workshops, IAP sessions and focus discussions on Schedule baselining and forecast exercises as required.
* Review, Tracking \& monitoring Schedule \& Critical areas through LEM and Scrums, raising the flag for the delays \& areas of concerns.
* Establish WBS and CBS required for the project as per the reporting requirements in line with the Client discussions.
* Interact with Project and department stakeholders in functional discussions and support required in delivering the Projects assigned.
* Preparation and analysis of Project performance statistics and analytics as appropriate.
* Lead to set up Project Cost reports, internal monitoring metrics and other reporting requirements.
* Monitoring \& controlling the cost by various analysis and time to time information Management about the risk areas.
* Performing Risk Analysis on the Schedule and provide inputs / recommendations.
* Generating various reports like Progress S\-curves, Lookahead Plan, Variance Analysis, Productivity Analysis.
* Invoicing, preparing Cash flow and presenting in the APEX monthly level meeting.
* Daily/Weekly/Monthly reports
* Attend Internal and Client review meetings as required to present the Project performance, Concerns, and recovery plans etc.
* Work closely with the Project and Engineering managers to ensure proactive approach on addressing project performance and recovery measures all times.
* Mentor and guide junior team members and impart knowledge transfer time to time.
* Participate internal innovative forums and contribute for the Digital growth in project delivery wherever possible.
* Preparation of project cost reports and provide forecast analysis and trends of the project.
* Liaise effectively with multidisciplinary teams, fostering collaborative relationships, and ensuring alignment between planning, execution, and project objectives.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* Tertiary qualifications in Graduate in Engineering/Technology.
* 8\+ years of experience in Working for similar type Projects/Industry experience.
* Proven leadership and communication skills
* Extensive experience in Oil \& Gas, energy sector \& Chemicals.
* Sound knowledge of Planning, Cost control and Monitoring.
* A dedication to client satisfaction
* Excellent relationship building and stakeholder management skills.
* You will be an enthusiastic team player, with excellent stakeholder management skills.
* Proactive thinking and solution\-oriented delivery.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

title: Senior Engineer – Bridges
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
   

  

 Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
   

  

 Context
   

  

 In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.
   

  

 CTR – Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High\-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to Detailed Design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world.
   

  

 CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. One of the major achievements of India CTR team has been the design of HS2 project in UK. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with Front Office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2\.
   

  

 CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi\-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil.
   

  

 We are seeking applications for the position of Sr. Lead Engineer \- Bridges for Delhi/Bangalore/Ahmedabad/Kolkata.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Take responsibility for Rail/Road bridge design, viaduct \& Structure design.
* Having experience designing steel structures/bridges with joint detailing.
* Prepare reports and calculations in line with Network Rail standards.
* Should take lead for team of 4\- 5 Junior Engineer’s / Draftsman.
* Plan and deliver bridge surveys and inspections, including recording of all relevant information
* Complete bridge assessment calculation and reporting.
* Manage delivery of projects – take responsibility for budget and resource deployment on projects.
* Where required take responsibility for project delivery to agreed budgets.
* Where required prepare estimates for work items.
* Identify scope change items.
* Manage resources at a project level to ensure utilization and productivity is maintained.
* Ensure compliance of the Systra Group policies, particularly on ethics, safety and adherence to Company ISO Standards.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* BE\-Civil \+ M.Tech in Structural Engineering
* 5 to 10 years of experience into relevant field.
* Experience on Software requirement Sofistick, Midas, Oasys.
* Actively working towards Professional qualification.
* Ability to work in a collaborative multi\-discipline design team.
* Ability to complete assigned tasks with minimal supervision and provide support and mentoring to others.
* Ability to travel to client sites and other SYSTRA offices will be required.


 We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job \- it’s a career!
   

  

 Workplace Type

title: Manager Operations
description:
**Some Careers Shine Brighter Than Others.**
 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
 **Manager Operations** 
**.**
**In This Role, You Will**
* Asset Servicing team is part of the Markets and Securities Services Operations functions. AS team processes all voluntary and mandatory corporate action (including Income processing) across various UK, Europe and MENA jurisdiction.
* The department is also responsible for data validation for Equity and UK income collectives and capital mandatory corporate action. Team is divided into mainly three sub\-groups \- corporate action team (processes all capital voluntary \& mandatory corporate action), Income processing team (processes for Dividend, Coupon interest payment \& Pool factor processing) and corporate action validation team (validates corporate action for Equity, UK Income collectives, Capital mandatory corporate action).
* Ensure high\-quality service to the business area in terms of funds ensuring that risks are minimized and profit is maximized through effective management of costs. Ensure that process and procedures are continually reviewed and improved and the changes are communicated and implemented effectively. The job also entails checking on internal audits and measures undertaken and regularly reviews them in order to maintain quality and productivity at the optimum level.
* Responsible for managing performance and deliveries of funds/client sign offs to valuation teams. Contribution towards sustainable savings in relation to Process Efficiencies
* Supporting each global product on a regional basis by function or market. To plan for standardization of Asset Servicing processes by sharing the best practices across the various markets with the aim to enhance cost effectiveness and efficiencies.
* Role will be of individual contributor in nature and will not have team reporting to the role. Continually assess the risks inherent in department processes and procedures.
* High level variation and specific manual processes required by Product/System/Client/jurisdiction/ client
* To be aware of the Operational Risk scenario associated with the role and to ensure that all actions during your employment with HSBC take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring. Ensure effective escalation process is in place.


**To Be Successful, You Will**
* Bachelor’s degree in commerce or qualifications in accounting/finance industry or relevant experience. Detailed understanding of single sub\-process, control points, end to end process risk.
* Excellent knowledge in accounting principles and fundamentals of accounting. Excellent knowledge of ICON/Geneva/Multifonds as accounting system.
* Excellent knowledge and relevant experience in Asset Servicing with clear understanding of the E2E Fund Accounting Model.
* Basic knowledge in custody, brokerage, depository, investment accounting, mutual funds and reconciliations.
* 3\-5 years of relevant Funds administration experience. Excellent Team Management skills with ability to handle personnel issues and strong team bonding.
* Efficient Time Management and ability to multitask work and priorities to meet defined deadlines. Ability to build excellent rapport and working relationships with other departments and jurisdiction thus ensuring smooth operations.
* Should have demonstrated behavior in line with HSBC values throughout. Strong working knowledge on MS Office
* Will be expected to maintain HSBC internal control standards, including the timely implementation of internal and external audit points, together with any issues raised by external regulators. Must be aware of the operational risk scenarios associated with this role and act upon pertinent risk (if any).


**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**
 www.hsbc.com/careers
   

  

 HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible work and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.”

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 As a TR\-ITC manager, you’ll contribute technically to Risk Assurance client engagements and internal projects. An important part of your role will be to actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. You’ll also identify potential business opportunities for EY within existing engagements and escalate these as appropriate. Similarly, you’ll anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with stakeholders as required.
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer(client/onshore). As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Participate in IT Risk and Assurance engagements.
* Proficiency in using audit software tools, data analytics techniques, and IT auditing techniques. Strong analytical skills are necessary for interpreting technical data, identifying patterns, anomalies, and areas of concern.
* Understanding of regulatory requirements and industry standards related to IT governance, data protection, privacy, and cybersecurity. This includes regulations such as GDPR, HIPAA, PCI\-DSS, and industry frameworks like COBIT and NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
* Knowledge of IT governance principles, structures, and processes to ensure that IT activities align with business objectives, comply with regulations, and mitigate risks appropriately.
* Proficiency in identifying, assessing, and managing IT\-related risks to ensure that adequate controls are in place to mitigate potential threats to the organization's information assets, systems, and operations.
* Familiarity with IT auditing principles, techniques, and tools to assess the effectiveness of IT controls, identify control deficiencies, and recommend remediation actions.
* Proficiency in understanding IT systems, networks, applications, and infrastructure to design and implement controls effectively. This includes knowledge of common technology platforms, such as operating systems, databases, cloud services, and cybersecurity tools.
* Strong project management skills are necessary for planning, coordinating, and executing internal control initiatives effectively. This includes managing resources, timelines, budgets, and deliverables to ensure that control objectives are achieved in a timely and efficient manner.
* The ability to lead and mentor a team of IT control professionals, providing guidance, support, and development opportunities. Strong leadership qualities include decision\-making, delegation, conflict resolution, and fostering a collaborative work environment.
* Building and maintaining effective relationships with key stakeholders, including senior management, IT leadership, internal auditors, external auditors, and regulatory authorities. This involves understanding stakeholder expectations, managing communications, and addressing concerns in a collaborative and constructive manner.
* Work effectively as a team member, sharing responsibility, providing support, maintaining communication and updating senior team members on progress


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience in application controls and Information security experience.
* Ability to build relationships with key stakeholders across different levels of seniority.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Conduct performance reviews and contribute to performance feedback for the team.


**Required Qualifications**
* Preferably Bachelor’s degree in (Finance/Accounting, Electronics, Electronics \& Telecommunications, Comp. Science)/MBA/M.Sc./CA
* Minimum of 7\-8 years of experience in internal controls and Internal Audit
* Enterprise risk services with specific focus on IT and related industry standards
* IT Risk Assurance framework
* Control frameworks such as COSO, internal control principles and related regulations including SOX and J\-SOX
* Preferred security skills related to a broad range of operating systems, databases or security tools, e.g., UNIX, Linux, Windows 2000 and NT, firewalls and IDS systems
* Familiarity with IT analysis, delivery and operations methods, including ITGC, ITAC,SDLC, PAM and CM
* Familiarity with security and risk standards such as ISO 27001\-2, PCI DSS, NIST, ITIL, COBIT
* Experience of security testing methods and techniques including network, operating and application system configuration review
* Application controls and security experience:
+ sensitive access and SOD testing
+ controls testing
+ Knowledge of data analysis tools like MS Excel, MS Access, MS SQL Server, ACL, Monarch, etc.

* Preferred Certifications: CISA

title: TC-CS-Cyber Architecture- OT and Engineering-infrastructure and Cloud Security- Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**IT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Senior Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead and scale the Zero Trust Security Portfolio across EY GDS. This role will be responsible for leading complex client programs, building high\-performing teams, and driving innovation across Infrastructure Security capabilities.
   

  

 The Senior Manager will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and internal leadership, helping organizations transition from traditional security to Zero Trust Security. The role requires deep experience in cybersecurity architecture, network security, and zero trust security in cyber.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise \& cloud environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Oversee deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
* Experience in zero\-trust and micro\-segmentation solutions including Zscaler, Guardicore and Illumio.
* Define logical patterns \& develop use cases for zero trust capabilities across Network, Identity \& Access Management, Device, Application and other security domains
* Work in multiple domains of security technologies viz Network segmentation, Application gateways, security automation, Firewalls, VPN, SDN, SD\-WAN, IAM solutions.
* Possess hands on experience in segmenting networks, applications, and data to limit exposure to attacks.
* Good exposure in requirement understanding, security frameworks, technical documentation, designing HLDs and LLDs.
* Well\-versed in encrypting all end\-to\-end communication regardless of the location, authorizing access to resources on a per\-session basis, enforcing the temporary and dynamic nature of authentication and authorization.
* Monitoring all assets to be in the most secure state possible and maintaining visibility into the security of the entire network and business's resources.
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of zero trust market needs/challenges and assist in the planning, design and development of go\-to\-market solutions.
* Understand SaaS based technologies and identity\-based micro\-segmentation for cloud workloads and their implications for the enterprise.
* Document or enhance documentation on zero\-trust architecture requirements.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s Zero Trust, Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of experience across Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Expertise in Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (NIST 800\-207, NIST 800\-53, ZT DoD, CISA ZTMM).
* Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.
* Deep technical understanding of zero trust architecture and solutioning of zero trust security components.
* Deep knowledge of services and service delivery approach and methodology for zero trust security including governance and operating models.
* Clearly demonstrates proven extensive abilities with leveraging creative thinking and problem\-solving skills, individual initiative, and utilizing Office 365, MS Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint) and Google Docs.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Engage with CISOs, CIOs, plant leadership, OT operations teams, technology leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career

**Power Apps \& SQL , Altreyx**
**Position Details**
 EY’s GDS Assurance Digital team’s mission is to develop, implement and integrate technology solutions that better serve our audit clients and engagement teams. As a member of EY’s core Assurance practice, you’ll develop a deep Audit related technical knowledge and outstanding database, data analytics and programming skills.

Often the data necessary to satisfy these ever\-increasing and complex regulations must be collected from a variety of systems and departments throughout an organization. * Strong experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, and the broader Power Platform.
* Proficiency in web development technologies, including React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Design and develop robust, scalable Power Apps and SharePoint Online solutions using the SharePoint Framework (SPFx) and other modern development practices.

title: Interior Project Manager
description:
**About Livspace:** 




 Founded in
 **2014** 
 , Livspace is created to simplify the fragmented home interiors journey for homeowners. What began as a solution to challenges like finding reliable designers, coordinating vendors, and ensuring quality and fair pricing has grown into one of the most trusted platforms for end\-to\-end home interior design and renovation.
 



 Today, with 120,000\+ homes delivered and 2,000\+ designers, Livspace stands at the intersection of design, technology, and execution excellence. We are building not just beautiful homes, but a new category of consumer experience in India.
 



 If you’re excited about building the future of home interiors and want to grow with one of the fastest\-growing brands, this is your opportunity to step in and make an impact with Livspace.
 



  





**Role: Operations Lead (Ops \+ Client Handling)** 




 Own end\-to\-end project execution with a focus on quality and timelines.Act as the primary client contact, ensuring regular updates and a smooth experience. Drive stakeholder alignment and issue resolution to ensure successful project completion.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 



* Take complete ownership of project execution from start to finish.
* Engage with clients and provide regular project updates (planned / ongoing / upcoming activities).
* Coordinate with manpower agencies to ensure timely resource allocation.
* Prepare and share Weekly Progress Reports (WPRs).
* Lead and guide installation teams to execute work as per design plans.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to ensure high\-quality execution and customer experience.
* Hire, mentor, and build a high\-performing operations team.
* Ensure strict adherence to processes, SOPs, and quality standards.



  





**Skills \& Experience.** 



* B.Tech in Civil / Architecture,B.Tech \+ MBA(Tier 1 / Tier 2 institutes preferred).
* Minimum 2\+ years of experience in interior fit\-out (residential/corporate).
* Strong understanding of project management fundamentals.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD, MS Excel/Google Sheets, MS Word.

title: Senior Project Control Specialist
description:
**About Us**
 Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI\-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.
   

  

**Purpose** 
 : To lead the Project Controls team and manage all project planning, scheduling and cost management activities to ensure that projects are completed on time, on budget and required project services are delivered to Worley, and its client’s requirements.
   

  

**The Role**
***As a Senior Project Control Specialist with Worley,***
 you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.
   

  

* Lead the team, manage employee development and support career progression for the function.
* Ensure the services the team deliver meet project requirements to specified quality, on time and are within budget.
* Drive a culture of accountability within the group and enforce necessary measures when performance is inadequate.
* Drive a culture of ‘doing it right first time’ and delivering high quality deliverables that are part of fit for purpose solutions.
* Drive adoption of GID’s new way of operating.
* Build capability in the function to match capability needs identified by Works Management.
* Support implementation of a high performance delivery and unified GID organisational culture which spans across geographic locations and cultures.
* When necessary, perform project controls services.
* Ensure Continuous Improvement through the implementation of an Annual Improvement Plan and addressing lessons learnt.
* Develop, implement, improve and maintain Worley project controls systems, processes, practices and procedures.
* Review proposals for suitability of project scope, cost and scheduling requirements and coordinates development of all data in support of negotiations in line with Worley guidelines.
* Review Control budgets prepared for the projects and monitor deviation of the project cost with respect to the budgets prepared.


**Additional Responsibilities**
* Interface with Project Management and Finance and Governance to prepare monthly internal reports, project control statements and MPRD reports.
* Partner with Workforce Planning to forecast personnel needs for projects.
* Liaise with other departments at meetings relative to project operations, to ensure that information affecting the project plan is continually updated.
* Proactively resolve any discrepancies between Worley and client’s requirements.
* Keep up to date with developments and innovations in the function.
* Demonstrate commitment to Zero Harm through regular actions and courageously speak up if work is being performed unsafely.
* Take accountability for own development and support the learning of others in areas of own experience by providing support to them as they are learning.
* Take initiative to get things done and do things before being asked by others.
* Apply standard procedures and processes to consistently deliver individual and team goals.
* Actively demonstrate WorleyParsons values and beliefs.
* Undertake any other reasonable duties as requested from time to time by the leadership team.


**About You**
 To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:
   

  

* 15\+ years of technical, practical and leadership experience in Project Controls in the same or similar industry, managing and leading large multi\-disciplinary projects and teams including 10\+ years of experience as project controls engineer / project planning engineer in engineering delivery organisation.
* Recognised degree in the relevant area or equivalent qualification/experience.
* Commercial experience, including contracts and procurement.
* Competent in the use of Primavera software package, Microsoft Excel, Access and other project controls specific software like PRA, Fuse etc.
* Able to make difficult decisions and lead others in changing business conditions.
* Can manage and resolve conflict between individuals and/or groups.
* Strong in negotiation of successful outcomes that achieve the required objectives and have the support and acceptance of all parties.


**Generic Competencies**
* Able to influence others, think ‘on your feet’ and have ability to work as part of a high performing team.
* Able to work effectively in small multi\-disciplinary teams, and share and transfer knowledge within teams.
* Able to share information to diverse audiences.
* Can listen and ask questions to ensure understanding.
* Able to use effective cross\-cultural communication skills.
* Able to develop and propose new approaches, methods, or technologies in response to changing business conditions.


**Moving forward together**
 We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.
   

  

 And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.
   

  

 And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

 All over the world people are using buildings, infrastructure, and assets we helped to deliver. It could be the hospital they work in, the railway they travel on every day, the fuel that powers their car or the data centre they depend on at work. For more than 75 years we’ve been helping to deliver transformational programmes across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors, making a difference to people’s lives and ensuring a return on investment for our clients and their investors.
   

  





**Our purpose:**




**Transforming performance for a green, inclusive, and productive world.**




 The world is changing and we have a responsibility to support that change, helping drive it and be part of it. Through the commitment, capability and care our team brings, we build trust between clients, suppliers, governments and society. Delivering better outcomes that have a positive impact on the world around us. We work smarter to face the challenges of the future; bringing the clarity that helps teams realise their full potential across the real estate, infrastructure and natural resources sectors. It’s how we’ve made the difference for more than 75 years.
   

  





**Our values:**




**Love a challenge:** 
 We love a challenge and we work hard to make change happen and see things through. We don’t stand still, challenging ourselves and others to do better every day. And we are trusted to do the right thing, raising standards all the time.
   

  





**Stronger together:** 
 We’re stronger together by connecting people in diverse teams, so that we can all collaborate to deliver our best work. We focus on what matters and use our influence to build a better world for everyone.
   

  





**Bring out the best in everyone:** 
 We bring out the best in everyone. We help each other to make the most of our potential, always learning from our experience. We treat each other with care and respect and make time to give everyone a voice
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 Job Summary
   

  





 We are looking for an experienced
 **Project Manager – Planning** 
 to lead project planning, scheduling, monitoring, and control activities across large\-scale construction, interior fit\-out, infrastructure, or real estate projects. The role will be responsible for developing project schedules, tracking progress, forecasting risks, and ensuring timely project delivery through effective planning and coordination with cross\-functional stakeholders.
   

  





 Key Responsibilities
   

  





 Project Planning \& Scheduling
   

  




* Develop detailed project schedules, work breakdown structures (WBS), and execution plans.
* Establish project milestones, critical paths, and resource\-loaded schedules.
* Prepare baseline schedules and monitor project performance against approved plans.
* Ensure alignment of project timelines with business objectives and client requirements.



 Project Monitoring \& Control
   

  




* Track project progress and identify schedule variances.
* Analyze delays, bottlenecks, and potential risks impacting project delivery.
* Generate daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports for management and clients.
* Monitor project productivity and recommend corrective actions to maintain timelines.



 Resource Planning
   

  




* Coordinate with project teams to optimize manpower, equipment, and material allocation.
* Develop resource histograms and workforce deployment plans.
* Ensure efficient utilization of project resources across multiple projects.



 Stakeholder Coordination
   

  




* Collaborate with project managers, design teams, procurement, and site execution teams.
* Facilitate planning review meetings and project status discussions.
* Provide planning insights and recommendations to senior leadership and clients.



 Risk Management
   

  




* Identify project risks, schedule constraints, and mitigation strategies.
* Conduct delay analysis and impact assessments.
* Develop recovery plans and acceleration programs whenever required.



 Cost \& Performance Reporting
   

  




* Support project control functions including cost tracking and forecasting.
* Monitor earned value metrics and project performance indicators.
* Prepare dashboards, MIS reports, and management presentations.
* Assist in budget planning and project forecasting activities.



 Documentation \& Compliance
   

  




* Maintain project planning documentation, schedules, and progress records.
* Ensure adherence to organizational project management standards and procedures.
* Support contract management by providing schedule\-related inputs for claims and extensions of time (EOT).



  

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

 Required Qualifications
   

  




* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related discipline.
* PMP, PMI\-SP, Primavera P6, or equivalent project planning certification preferred.
* 10–12 years of experience in project planning and controls within construction, infrastructure, real estate, or interior fit\-out projects.
* Experience managing planning functions for large and complex projects.



 Required Skills \& Competencies
   

  




* Expert knowledge of
 **Primavera P6** 
 , MS Project, and project scheduling techniques.
* Strong understanding of Critical Path Method (CPM) and project control methodologies.
* Proficiency in project reporting, forecasting, and schedule analysis.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong leadership and coordination abilities.
* Advanced knowledge of project lifecycle management.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Power BI, and project management tools.


**Additional Information**

 Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.
   

  





 We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work\-life balance.
   

  





 Turner \& Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.
   

  





 Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/

**About Intelligent Consulting Engineers (ICE):** 

 Founded in 2015, Intelligent Consulting Engineers (ICE) is an independent BIM and Engineering consultancy (MNC) based in Finland, India, North America, and Estonia delivering services all over the world. Our geographic footprint stretches across more than 15 countries in Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia with a collective experience of more than 500 projects. Our teams excels in engineering experiences through Building Information Modelling (BIM), continually redefining industry standards. Committed to a collaborative and growth\-oriented workplace, ICE offers opportunities for professionals to contribute to pioneering projects, influence the future of construction, and advance their careers within a company dedicated to excellence and technological leadership.
 





  
 




**Website Link:** 

 https://icengg.com/
 




  





**BIM Structural Project Delivery Head (PDH)** 




**Location:** 
 New Town, Kolkata
 



**Working Days:** 
 5 Days a week.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced BIM Structural Project Delivery Head (PDH) to lead structural BIM project delivery, manage teams, and drive projects from planning through successful completion.The ideal candidate should bring strong experience in Structural BIM, project delivery, team leadership, client coordination, and project execution.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end Structural BIM project delivery and ensure timely, high\-quality deliverables.
* Manage, mentor, and develop BIM Structural teams.
* Plan resources, monitor project schedules, productivity, quality, and overall delivery performance.
* Oversee BIM modelling, coordination, detailing, clash resolution, and model quality.
* Coordinate with clients and internal stakeholders to address technical and project\-related challenges.
* Identify project risks and implement effective solutions to keep delivery on track.
* Drive BIM standards, workflows, process improvements, and delivery excellence.



  





**Requirements** 



* Minimum 12\+ years of experience in Structural BIM and Project Delivery.
* B.Tech in Civil Engineering / Structural Engineering – Mandatory.
* Strong experience in Structural BIM and Project Delivery.
* Proven experience in leading BIM Structural teams and managing projects.
* Strong understanding of BIM processes, structural modelling, coordination, and detailing.
* Excellent leadership, client communication, decision\-making, and problem\-solving skills.
* Precast experience will be an added advantage.
* Tekla experience will be an added advantage.
* Civil 3D experience will be an added advantage.

title: Senior Project Coordinator
description:
Job Description \- Senior C\&I; /Senior Project Coordinator
 



 Project: Corporate Interior Design / Fit\-out Projects
 



 Locations: Kolkata
 



 Experience: Minimum 10\+ years
 



 Deployment: Full\-time at Project Site
 



 Role Summary
 



 RSP is looking for an experienced Interior Site Coordinator to represent the design team at site for large\-scale
 



 Accenture corporate interior projects. The candidate will act as the key interface between the RSP design team,
 



 Client, PMC, contractors, vendors and other consultants, ensuring that the approved design intent is correctly
 



 translated and implemented at site.
 



 The candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in corporate workplace interior projects and be capable of
 



 independently handling design coordination, site queries, shop drawings, approvals and execution\-related design
 



 issues.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 • Represent the RSP Interior Design team at site and manage day\-to\-day design coordination.
 



 • Review site execution against approved GFC drawings, specifications and design intent.
 



 • Coordinate with Client, PMC, contractors, vendors, MEP consultants and the RSP design team.
 



 • Review and coordinate interior shop drawings including partitions, ceilings, flooring, wall finishes, doors, joinery,
 



 furniture and other interior elements.
 



 • Review site conditions and identify discrepancies between drawings and actual site conditions.
 



 • Coordinate architectural/interior works with MEP services and resolve interface and ceiling coordination issues.
 



 • Track and facilitate timely closure of RFIs, shop drawings, material submissions, samples and design\-related
 



 approvals.
 



 • Review material and finish samples, mock\-ups and installations for compliance with approved design intent.
 



 • Conduct regular site walks and identify deviations from approved drawings and design requirements.
 



 • Coordinate critical dimensions, setting\-out requirements and site measurements affecting the design.
 



 • Attend project/site coordination meetings and provide design\-related inputs and clarifications.
 



 • Identify potential design and coordination issues in advance and escalate them to the appropriate design/project
 



 teams for timely resolution.
 



 • Coordinate with the RSP design team for required drawing revisions, details and site clarifications.
 



 • Maintain proper records of RFIs, shop drawings, design changes, approvals and site observations.
 



 • Monitor closure of design\-related site observations and snags.
 



 • Provide regular progress and issue updates to the RSP Project/Design Manager.
 



 • Ensure that the overall design intent, quality and detailing standards are maintained throughout execution.
 



 Qualification \& Experience
 



 • Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Architecture, Interior Design or Civil Engineering.
 



 • Minimum 10 years of relevant professional experience, with substantial experience in corporate
 



 workplace/interior fit\-out projects.
 



 RSP Design Consultants (India) Pvt Ltd \- Accenture Project Page 2
 



 • Strong knowledge of corporate interior construction, detailing, materials, finishes, joinery and fit\-out
 



 methodology.
 



 • Proven experience in coordinating large and fast\-track corporate interior projects.
 



 • Strong ability to read and interpret architectural, interior, shop and MEP drawings.
 



 • Good understanding of MEP interfaces within interior fit\-out projects.
 



 • Proficiency in AutoCAD and MS Office; working knowledge of Revit/BIM will be an advantage.
 



 • Strong communication, coordination, documentation and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Ability to independently represent the Design Consultant at site and coordinate with multiple stakeholders.
 



 Preferred Profile
 



 Candidates with previous experience in large corporate workplace projects for multinational clients,
 



 particularly projects involving multiple consultants, PMCs, contractors and specialist vendors, will be preferred.

title: Site Supervisor
description:
**Company Description** 
 Garuda Design Studio is a collaborative practice of designers, architects, engineers, and project managers dedicated to creating thoughtful, functional living spaces. The studio focuses on vernacular contemporary design, blending local character with modern comfort and usability. Projects emphasize purity in design, natural materials, and a strong connection to the surrounding environment. Team members work closely together to deliver spaces that feel cozy, livable, and intentionally crafted. The culture supports creativity, technical excellence, and a commitment to sustainable, people\-centered design.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Site Supervisor is a full\-time, on\-site role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, responsible for overseeing day\-to\-day activities at project sites. This position coordinates with designers, architects, engineers, contractors, and vendors to ensure that work is executed according to drawings, specifications, and safety standards. Daily responsibilities include monitoring site progress, managing manpower and resources, maintaining quality control, and documenting work through reports, photographs, and checklists. The Site Supervisor also handles basic issue resolution on site, escalates technical concerns to the design and engineering teams, and supports adherence to timelines and budgets. The role involves regular site inspections, communication with clients or client representatives, and ensuring compliance with local regulations and company procedures.
   

**Qualifications**
* Ability to supervise construction sites, including monitoring daily activities, coordinating trades, and ensuring adherence to design and technical specifications.
* Strong skills in site planning and organization, including scheduling, resource allocation, and basic project coordination with internal teams and external vendors.
* Working knowledge of construction methods, materials, and finishes relevant to residential and vernacular contemporary designs, with attention to quality and safety.
* Competence in documenting site work through reports, measurements, photographs, and checklists, and maintaining accurate records for project tracking.
* Effective interpersonal and communication skills for collaborating with architects, engineers, contractors, and clients, and for resolving routine on\-site issues.
* Ability to interpret architectural and engineering drawings, and translate plans into clear instructions for site teams.
* Understanding of basic health, safety, and environmental standards applicable to construction sites in the Kolkata metropolitan area.
* Relevant experience as a Site Supervisor or similar role in architecture, interior design, or construction projects; residential or small\-scale projects experience is advantageous.
* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or a related field is preferred; equivalent hands\-on experience may be considered.
* Willingness to work primarily on site, travel between project locations within the metropolitan area, and adapt to changing project demands.
